This file is a merged representation of the entire codebase, combined into a single document by Repomix.

================================================================
File Summary
================================================================

Purpose:
--------
This file contains a packed representation of the entire repository's contents.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:
------------
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:
------
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

import { useState } from "react";
import { Link, Outlet, useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

export default function CMSLayout() {
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [isSidebarOpen, setIsSidebarOpen] = useState(true);

  const menuItems = [
    { name: "Dashboard", path: "/cms/dashboard", icon: "📊" },
    { name: "Publications", path: "/cms/publications", icon: "📰" },
    { name: "Project Tracker", path: "/cms/projects", icon: "🏗️" },
    { name: "Sanctions", path: "/cms/sanctions", icon: "⚖️" },
    { name: "Complaints", path: "/cms/complaints", icon: "📝" },
  ];

  const handleLogout = () => {
    // In the future, this will clear the auth token
    navigate("/cms/login");
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", height: "100vh", backgroundColor: "#F1F5F9", fontFamily: "'Inter', sans-serif" }}>
      
      {/* SIDEBAR */}
      <div style={{ 
        width: isSidebarOpen ? "260px" : "80px", 
        backgroundColor: "#001F3F", 
        color: "#FFFFFF", 
        display: "flex", 
        flexDirection: "column",
        transition: "width 0.3s ease",
        overflow: "hidden"
      }}>
        {/* Sidebar Header */}
        <div style={{ padding: "24px 20px", borderBottom: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
          <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "18px", fontWeight: "800", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
            {isSidebarOpen ? "VFMO CMS" : "V"}
          </h2>
          <button onClick={() => setIsSidebarOpen(!isSidebarOpen)} style={{ background: "none", border: "none", color: "#FFFFFF", cursor: "pointer", fontSize: "18px" }}>
            {isSidebarOpen ? "◀" : "▶"}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Sidebar Navigation */}
        <nav style={{ flex: 1, padding: "20px 10px", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "8px" }}>
          {menuItems.map((item) => {
            const isActive = location.pathname === item.path;
            return (
              <Link
                key={item.name}
                to={item.path}
                style={{
                  display: "flex",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  gap: "16px",
                  padding: "14px 16px",
                  borderRadius: "8px",
                  textDecoration: "none",
                  color: isActive ? "#001F3F" : "#CBD5E1",
                  backgroundColor: isActive ? "#FCD116" : "transparent",
                  fontWeight: isActive ? "700" : "500",
                  transition: "all 0.2s ease",
                  whiteSpace: "nowrap"
                }}
              >
                <span style={{ fontSize: "20px" }}>{item.icon}</span>
                {isSidebarOpen && <span>{item.name}</span>}
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        {/* Logout */}
        <div style={{ padding: "20px", borderTop: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)" }}>
          <button 
            onClick={handleLogout}
            style={{ 
              width: "100%", padding: "12px", borderRadius: "6px", 
              backgroundColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)", color: "#FFFFFF", 
              border: "none", fontWeight: "600", cursor: "pointer",
              display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", gap: "8px"
            }}
          >
            <span>🚪</span>
            {isSidebarOpen && <span>Logout</span>}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* MAIN CONTENT AREA */}
      <div style={{ flex: 1, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", overflow: "hidden" }}>
        
        {/* TOP BAR */}
        <header style={{ 
          backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", 
          padding: "16px 32px", 
          borderBottom: "1px solid #E2E8F0",
          display: "flex",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          alignItems: "center"
        }}>
          <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "20px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A" }}>
            {menuItems.find(item => item.path === location.pathname)?.name || "Admin Panel"}
          </h1>
          
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "16px" }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#64748B", fontWeight: "600" }}>Admin User</span>
            <div style={{ width: "40px", height: "40px", borderRadius: "50%", backgroundColor: "#001F3F", color: "#FFFFFF", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", fontWeight: "800" }}>
              A
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* PAGE CONTENT (Renders the sub-pages) */}
        <main style={{ flex: 1, padding: "32px", overflowY: "auto" }}>
          <Outlet />
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

File: src/cms/pages/Login.jsx

import { useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

export default function CMSLogin() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");

  const handleLogin = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    // In the future, this is where the API call goes
    navigate("/cms/dashboard");
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", height: "100vh", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", backgroundColor: "#F1F5F9", fontFamily: "'Inter', sans-serif" }}>
      <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", padding: "48px", borderRadius: "16px", boxShadow: "0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)", width: "100%", maxWidth: "400px", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0" }}>
        
        <div style={{ textAlign: "center", marginBottom: "32px" }}>
          <h1 style={{ fontSize: "24px", fontWeight: "900", color: "#001F3F", margin: "0 0 8px 0" }}>VFMO CMS</h1>
          <p style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#64748B", margin: 0 }}>Sign in to manage website content</p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleLogin} style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "20px" }}>
          <div>
            <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#475569", marginBottom: "6px" }}>Email Address</label>
            <input 
              type="email" 
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="admin@vfmo.gov.gh"
              style={{ width: "100%", padding: "12px", borderRadius: "8px", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", fontSize: "14px", outline: "none", boxSizing: "border-box" }}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#475569", marginBottom: "6px" }}>Password</label>
            <input 
              type="password" 
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="••••••••"
              style={{ width: "100%", padding: "12px", borderRadius: "8px", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", fontSize: "14px", outline: "none", boxSizing: "border-box" }}
            />
          </div>
          
          <button type="submit" style={{ backgroundColor: "#001F3F", color: "#FFFFFF", border: "none", padding: "14px", borderRadius: "8px", fontSize: "15px", fontWeight: "700", cursor: "pointer", marginTop: "8px" }}>
            Sign In
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// src/cms/pages/ManagePublications.jsx
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  categories,
  getPublications,
  savePublications,
} from "../services/mockData";

export default function ManagePublications() {
  // Reads from localStorage if the CMS has saved anything, otherwise the original site data.
  // Nothing is written until the admin publishes or deletes something.
  const [publications, setPublications] = useState(() => getPublications());
  const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = useState(false);

  // Form state
  const [newTitle, setNewTitle] = useState("");
  const [newDesc, setNewDesc] = useState("");
  const [newTag, setNewTag] = useState(categories[0]);
  const [newImage, setNewImage] = useState(null);

  // Convert uploaded image to base64 so it survives reloads
  // (blob: URLs die the moment you refresh or navigate)
  const handleImageChange = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => setNewImage(reader.result);
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  // Central save helper. Writes to localStorage and notifies the website.
  // State only updates after a successful write. Returns true if saved.
  const persist = (updatedPubs) => {
    try {
      savePublications(updatedPubs);
      setPublications(updatedPubs);
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      alert(
        "Failed to save. Storage is likely full (5MB limit). " +
          "Try a smaller image or delete some publications."
      );
      console.error(err);
      return false;
    }
  };

  const handleSave = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const newPub = {
      id: `pub-${Date.now()}`,
      date: new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
        month: "short",
        day: "numeric",
        year: "numeric",
      }),
      tag: newTag,
      title: newTitle,
      desc: newDesc,
      image: newImage || "/about-bg.jpg",
    };

    // New items go to the FRONT so the Publications page shows them first
    if (!persist([newPub, ...publications])) return;

    // Reset form
    setIsCreating(false);
    setNewTitle("");
    setNewDesc("");
    setNewTag(categories[0]);
    setNewImage(null);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to delete this publication?")) return;
    persist(publications.filter((p) => p.id !== id));
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "24px" }}>
      {/* HEADER ACTION BAR */}
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
        <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "20px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A" }}>
          {isCreating ? "Create New Publication" : "All Publications"}
        </h2>
        <button
          onClick={() => setIsCreating(!isCreating)}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: isCreating ? "#E2E8F0" : "#001F3F",
            color: isCreating ? "#0F172A" : "#FFFFFF",
            border: "none",
            padding: "12px 24px",
            borderRadius: "8px",
            fontSize: "14px",
            fontWeight: "700",
            cursor: "pointer",
            transition: "all 0.2s",
          }}
        >
          {isCreating ? "Cancel" : "+ Add Publication"}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* CREATE FORM */}
      {isCreating && (
        <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", padding: "32px", borderRadius: "12px", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0" }}>
          <form onSubmit={handleSave} style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "20px" }}>
            <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: "20px" }}>
              <div>
                <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#475569", marginBottom: "6px" }}>Title</label>
                <input
                  required
                  value={newTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTitle(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ width: "100%", padding: "12px", borderRadius: "6px", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", outline: "none" }}
                  placeholder="e.g., New Procurement Guidelines Issued"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#475569", marginBottom: "6px" }}>Category Tag</label>
                <select
                  value={newTag}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTag(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ width: "100%", padding: "12px", borderRadius: "6px", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", outline: "none", backgroundColor: "#FFF" }}
                >
                  {categories.map((cat) => (
                    <option key={cat} value={cat}>{cat}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#475569", marginBottom: "6px" }}>Cover Image</label>
              <div
                style={{
                  border: "2px dashed #CBD5E1",
                  borderRadius: "8px",
                  padding: "24px",
                  textAlign: "center",
                  backgroundColor: "#F8FAFC",
                  position: "relative",
                  cursor: "pointer",
                }}
              >
                <input
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/*"
                  onChange={handleImageChange}
                  style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, width: "100%", height: "100%", opacity: 0, cursor: "pointer" }}
                />
                {newImage ? (
                  <div>
                    <img src={newImage} alt="Preview" style={{ maxHeight: "100px", borderRadius: "4px", marginBottom: "8px" }} />
                    <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "13px", color: "#10B981", fontWeight: "600" }}>Image selected! Click to change.</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div>
                    <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" strokeWidth="2" style={{ marginBottom: "8px" }}>
                      <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"></path>
                      <polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"></polyline>
                      <line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"></line>
                    </svg>
                    <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "14px", color: "#475569", fontWeight: "600" }}>Click to upload or drag and drop</p>
                    <p style={{ margin: "4px 0 0 0", fontSize: "12px", color: "#64748B" }}>JPG, PNG (Max ~1MB recommended for demo)</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#475569", marginBottom: "6px" }}>Description</label>
              <textarea
                required
                value={newDesc}
                onChange={(e) => setNewDesc(e.target.value)}
                rows="4"
                style={{ width: "100%", padding: "12px", borderRadius: "6px", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", outline: "none", resize: "vertical" }}
                placeholder="Write the summary of the press release..."
              />
            </div>

            <div style={{ marginTop: "16px", padding: "24px", backgroundColor: "#F8FAFC", border: "1px dashed #CBD5E1", borderRadius: "8px" }}>
              <p style={{ margin: "0 0 12px 0", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase" }}>Live Preview</p>
              <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#0A2E4D", borderRadius: "12px", padding: "24px", maxWidth: "400px", overflow: "hidden" }}>
                {newImage && <img src={newImage} alt="" style={{ width: "100%", height: "120px", objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: "8px", marginBottom: "16px" }} />}
                <span style={{ fontSize: "11px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#FCD116", textTransform: "uppercase" }}>{newTag || "TAG"}</span>
                <h3 style={{ color: "#FFFFFF", margin: "8px 0", fontSize: "18px" }}>{newTitle || "Publication Title Here"}</h3>
                <p style={{ color: "#CBD5E1", fontSize: "14px", margin: 0 }}>{newDesc || "Description will appear here..."}</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              style={{ backgroundColor: "#10B981", color: "#FFFFFF", border: "none", padding: "16px", borderRadius: "8px", fontSize: "16px", fontWeight: "700", cursor: "pointer", marginTop: "16px" }}
            >
              Publish to Website
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* LIST OF PUBLICATIONS */}
      {!isCreating && (
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr", gap: "16px" }}>
          {publications.length === 0 && (
            <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", padding: "32px", borderRadius: "12px", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0", textAlign: "center", color: "#64748B", fontSize: "14px" }}>
              No publications. Use "Reset Demo Data" on the dashboard to restore the original content.
            </div>
          )}
          {publications.map((pub) => (
            <div
              key={pub.id}
              style={{
                backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
                padding: "24px",
                borderRadius: "12px",
                border: "1px solid #E2E8F0",
                display: "flex",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: "16px",
              }}
            >
              {pub.image && (
                <img
                  src={pub.image}
                  alt=""
                  style={{ width: "80px", height: "60px", objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: "6px", flexShrink: 0 }}
                />
              )}
              <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: "11px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#001F3F", backgroundColor: "#FCD116", padding: "4px 8px", borderRadius: "4px", textTransform: "uppercase" }}>{pub.tag}</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#64748B", marginLeft: "12px", fontWeight: "600" }}>{pub.date}</span>
                <h3 style={{ margin: "8px 0 4px 0", fontSize: "18px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A" }}>{pub.title}</h3>
                <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "14px", color: "#475569", maxWidth: "600px" }}>{pub.desc}</p>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "8px" }}>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleDelete(pub.id)}
                  style={{ padding: "8px 16px", backgroundColor: "#FEF2F2", color: "#B91C1C", border: "1px solid #FECACA", borderRadius: "6px", fontWeight: "700", cursor: "pointer" }}
                >
                  Delete
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: src/components/TextSplitter.jsx
================
import { motion } from "framer-motion";

export default function SplitText({ text, hoveredWord, baseColor, hoverColor }) {
  const words = text.split(" ");

  return (
    <span style={{ display: "inline-block", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
      {words.map((word, wordIndex) => (
        <span key={wordIndex} style={{ display: "inline-block", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
          {word.split("").map((char, charIndex) => {
            
            const isWordHovered = hoveredWord === text;

            return (
              <motion.span
                key={charIndex}
                initial={{ opacity: 1, z: 0, y: 0, color: baseColor, textShadow: "2px 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)" }}
                animate={
                  isWordHovered
                    ? { 
                        z: 50, 
                        y: -5, 
                        color: hoverColor, 
                        textShadow: "0 20px 30px rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.3)" 
                      }
                    : { 
                        z: 0, 
                        y: 0, 
                        color: baseColor, 
                        textShadow: "2px 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)" 
                      }
                }
                transition={{
                  type: "spring",
                  stiffness: 300,
                  damping: 20,
                  delay: isWordHovered ? charIndex * 0.02 : 0, 
                }}
                style={{ display: "inline-block" }}
              >
                {char}
              </motion.span>
            );
          })}
          <span style={{ display: "inline-block", width: "0.3em" }}></span>
        </span>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

import PortalLayout from "../components/PortalLayout";

export default function Assessments() {
  const allAssessments = [
    { id: "VFM-2026-0142", entity: "Ministry of Roads", project: "Tema Interchange Phase 2", value: "₵48.2M", status: "Under Review", statusColor: "#FCD116" },
    { id: "VFM-2026-0141", entity: "Ghana Health Service", project: "Regional Hospital Equipment", value: "₵12.7M", status: "Clarification", statusColor: "#EF4444" },
    { id: "VFM-2026-0140", entity: "Ministry of Education", project: "STEM School Construction", value: "₵86.4M", status: "Under Review", statusColor: "#FCD116" },
    { id: "VFM-2026-0139", entity: "Ghana Water Co.", project: "Pipeline Expansion", value: "₵31.5M", status: "Approved", statusColor: "#10B981" },
    { id: "VFM-2026-0138", entity: "Ministry of Defence", project: "Barracks Renovation", value: "₵105.3M", status: "Under Review", statusColor: "#FCD116" },
  ];

  return (
    <PortalLayout pageTitle="Assessments" pageSubtitle="Manage and review all VfM assessment requests.">
      
      {/* FILTERS */}
      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "12px", marginBottom: "24px" }}>
        <button style={{ padding: "8px 16px", backgroundColor: "#001F3F", color: "#FFFFFF", border: "none", borderRadius: "6px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "600", cursor: "pointer" }}>All</button>
        <button style={{ padding: "8px 16px", backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", color: "#475569", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0", borderRadius: "6px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "600", cursor: "pointer" }}>Under Review</button>
        <button style={{ padding: "8px 16px", backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", color: "#475569", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0", borderRadius: "6px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "600", cursor: "pointer" }}>Clarification</button>
        <button style={{ padding: "8px 16px", backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", color: "#475569", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0", borderRadius: "6px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "600", cursor: "pointer" }}>Approved</button>
      </div>

      {/* FULL TABLE */}
      <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", borderRadius: "12px", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0", boxShadow: "0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.02)", overflow: "hidden" }}>
        <div style={{ overflowX: "auto" }}>
          <table style={{ width: "100%", borderCollapse: "collapse", textAlign: "left" }}>
            <thead>
              <tr style={{ backgroundColor: "#F8FAFC", borderBottom: "1px solid #E2E8F0" }}>
                <th style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "1px" }}>Reference</th>
                <th style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "1px" }}>Entity & Project</th>
                <th style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "1px" }}>Value</th>
                <th style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "1px" }}>Status</th>
                <th style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "1px" }}>Action</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {allAssessments.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index} style={{ borderBottom: "1px solid #E2E8F0" }}>
                  <td style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#001F3F" }}>{row.id}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: "16px 24px" }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#0F172A" }}>{row.entity}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#64748B", marginTop: "4px" }}>{row.project}</div>
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#0F172A" }}>{row.value}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: "16px 24px" }}>
                    <span style={{ display: "inline-block", padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: "20px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "700", backgroundColor: `${row.statusColor}15`, color: row.statusColor }}>
                      {row.status}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: "16px 24px" }}>
                    <button style={{ padding: "6px 12px", backgroundColor: "transparent", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", borderRadius: "4px", fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: "600", color: "#001F3F", cursor: "pointer" }}>Review</button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

    </PortalLayout>

import PortalLayout from "../components/PortalLayout";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Link, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { ChevronDown, Send, Search, ExternalLink, HelpCircle, X } from "lucide-react";
import { helpArticles } from "../data/helpData";

// Conversational filler words to strip out so natural language queries match
const STOP_WORDS = new Set([
  "how", "do", "i", "can", "we", "the", "a", "an", "is", "are", 
  "to", "for", "of", "in", "on", "what", "where", "when", "why", 
  "who", "which", "my", "our", "it", "with", "about", "at", "by", 
  "or", "and", "from", "be", "get", "need", "want"
]);

// Fast Levenshtein distance for typo tolerance
function getEditDistance(a, b) {
  if (a.length === 0) return b.length;
  if (b.length === 0) return a.length;

  const matrix = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= b.length; i++) matrix[i] = [i];
  for (let j = 0; j <= a.length; j++) matrix[0][j] = j;

  for (let i = 1; i <= b.length; i++) {
    for (let j = 1; j <= a.length; j++) {
      if (b.charAt(i - 1) === a.charAt(j - 1)) {
        matrix[i][j] = matrix[i - 1][j - 1];
      } else {
        matrix[i][j] = Math.min(
          matrix[i - 1][j - 1] + 1,
          matrix[i - 1][j - 1] + 1,
          matrix[i - 1][j] + 1
        );
      }
    }
  }
  return matrix[b.length][a.length];
}

function isFuzzyMatch(word, target) {
  if (target.includes(word) || word.includes(target)) return true;
  if (word.length <= 3) return word === target;
  const maxDistance = word.length >= 6 ? 2 : 1;
  return getEditDistance(word, target) <= maxDistance;
}

function searchArticles(rawQuery, articles) {
  if (!rawQuery || !rawQuery.trim()) {
    return articles;
  }

  const cleanQuery = rawQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
  const rawTokens = cleanQuery.replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, " ").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const meaningfulTokens = rawTokens.filter((token) => !STOP_WORDS.has(token));
  const searchTokens = meaningfulTokens.length > 0 ? meaningfulTokens : rawTokens;

  const scoredArticles = articles.map((article) => {
    let score = 0;
    const titleLower = article.title.toLowerCase();
    const answerLower = article.answer.toLowerCase();
    const categoryLower = article.category.toLowerCase();
    const keywordsLower = article.keywords.map((k) => k.toLowerCase());

    if (titleLower.includes(cleanQuery)) score += 50;
    if (keywordsLower.some((k) => k.includes(cleanQuery))) score += 40;
    if (answerLower.includes(cleanQuery)) score += 15;

    searchTokens.forEach((token) => {
      if (titleLower.includes(token)) {
        score += 15;
      } else if (titleLower.split(/\s+/).some((w) => isFuzzyMatch(token, w))) {
        score += 8;
      }

      if (keywordsLower.some((k) => k === token)) {
        score += 20;
      } else if (keywordsLower.some((k) => k.includes(token))) {
        score += 12;
      } else if (keywordsLower.some((k) => isFuzzyMatch(token, k))) {
        score += 7;
      }

      if (categoryLower.includes(token)) {
        score += 8;
      }

      if (answerLower.includes(token)) {
        score += 4;
      }
    });

    return { article, score };
  });

  return scoredArticles
    .filter((item) => item.score > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
    .map((item) => item.article);
}

export default function Faq() {
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const urlQuery = searchParams.get("q") || "";

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState(urlQuery);
  const [openFaq, setOpenFaq] = useState(null);
  const [formStatus, setFormStatus] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ name: "", email: "", question: "" });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (urlQuery) {
      setSearchQuery(urlQuery);
    }
  }, [urlQuery]);

  const filteredArticles = searchArticles(searchQuery, helpArticles);

  const groupedArticles = filteredArticles.reduce((acc, article) => {
    if (!acc[article.category]) acc[article.category] = [];
    acc[article.category].push(article);
    return acc;
  }, {});

  const popularPills = [
    "Certificate of Clearance",
    "Track Complaint",
    "Penalty for Inflation",
    "Debarred Contractors",
    "Portal Login",
    "Whistleblower Policy",
  ];

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFormStatus(true);
    setFormData({ name: "", email: "", question: "" });
    setTimeout(() => setFormStatus(false), 6000);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#F4F5F0", minHeight: "100vh" }}>
      
      {/* HERO & SEARCH SECTION */}
      <section style={{ backgroundColor: "#001F3F", padding: "120px 24px 80px", textAlign: "center", position: "relative", overflow: "hidden" }}>
        <div style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, backgroundImage: "url(/building-bg.jpg)", backgroundSize: "cover", backgroundPosition: "center", opacity: 0.15, zIndex: 0 }} />
        <div style={{ maxWidth: "800px", margin: "0 auto", position: "relative", zIndex: 1 }}>
          
          <div style={{ width: "64px", height: "64px", backgroundColor: "rgba(252, 209, 22, 0.1)", borderRadius: "50%", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", margin: "0 auto 24px auto" }}>
            <HelpCircle size={32} color="#FCD116" />
          </div>

          <h1 style={{ fontSize: "48px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#FFFFFF", marginBottom: "20px", lineHeight: "1.1" }}>
            How Can We Help You?
          </h1>
          <p style={{ fontSize: "18px", color: "#CBD5E1", lineHeight: "1.6", marginBottom: "36px", maxWidth: "600px", marginLeft: "auto", marginRight: "auto" }}>
            Search our knowledge base for instant answers about VfM assessments, clearance, sanctions, or the Portal.
          </p>
          
          {/* SEARCH BAR */}
          <div style={{ position: "relative", maxWidth: "640px", margin: "0 auto 24px auto" }}>
            <Search size={22} color="#64748B" style={{ position: "absolute", left: "24px", top: "22px" }} />
            <input 
              type="text" 
              placeholder="Ask anything (e.g. 'how do i check if a company is banned?')..." 
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              style={{
                width: "100%", padding: "22px 64px 22px 64px", borderRadius: "12px", border: "none",
                fontSize: "17px", outline: "none", boxShadow: "0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)",
                boxSizing: "border-box", color: "#001F3F"
              }}
            />
            {searchQuery && (
              <div style={{ position: "absolute", right: "20px", top: "18px", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px" }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#001F3F", backgroundColor: "#FCD116", padding: "6px 14px", borderRadius: "20px" }}>
                  {filteredArticles.length} found
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}
                  style={{ background: "none", border: "none", cursor: "pointer", color: "#94A3B8", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", padding: "4px" }}
                >
                  <X size={18} />
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* POPULAR SEARCH PILLS (Star icon removed) */}
          <div style={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", justifyContent: "center", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", maxWidth: "700px", margin: "0 auto" }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#94A3B8", fontWeight: "600", marginRight: "4px" }}>
              Popular:
            </span>
            {popularPills.map((pill, i) => (
              <button
                key={i}
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery(pill)}
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)",
                  color: "#E2E8F0",
                  border: "1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)",
                  padding: "6px 14px",
                  borderRadius: "20px",
                  fontSize: "12px",
                  cursor: "pointer",
                  transition: "all 0.2s ease",
                }}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = "rgba(252, 209, 22, 0.25)")}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)")}

            ))}
          </div>

        </div>
      </section>

      {/* KNOWLEDGE BASE */}
      <section style={{ maxWidth: "1000px", margin: "0 auto", padding: "60px 24px 100px" }}>
        {filteredArticles.length > 0 ? (
          Object.entries(groupedArticles).map(([category, articles]) => (

                <h2 style={{ fontSize: "24px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A", margin: 0 }}>
                  {category}
                </h2>
                <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#64748B", fontWeight: "600", backgroundColor: "#E2E8F0", padding: "4px 10px", borderRadius: "20px" }}>
                  {articles.length} article{articles.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "12px" }}>
                {articles.map((article, index) => {
                  const globalIndex = `${category}-${index}`;
                  const isOpen = openFaq === globalIndex;
                  
                  return (
                    <div 
                      key={globalIndex} 
                      style={{

                        borderRadius: "10px", 
                        border: "1px solid #E2E8F0",
                        overflow: "hidden", 
                        transition: "all 0.2s ease",
                        boxShadow: isOpen ? "0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)" : "0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.02)"
                      }}
                    >
                      <div 
                        onClick={() => setOpenFaq(isOpen ? null : globalIndex)}
                        style={{ 
                          padding: "20px 28px", 
                          display: "flex", 
                          justifyContent: "space-between", 
                          alignItems: "center", 
                          cursor: "pointer", 
                        }}
                      >
                        <h3 style={{ fontSize: "17px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#0F172A", margin: 0, paddingRight: "24px" }}>
                          {article.title}
                        </h3>
                        <div style={{ 
                          width: "32px",

                          display: "flex",

                        </div>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div style={{

                          <p style={{ margin: "0 0 16px 0", fontSize: "15px", color: "#475569", lineHeight: "1.7" }}>
                            {article.answer}
                          </p>
                          {article.link && (

================
File: src/utils/searchEngine.js
================
// src/utils/searchEngine.js

// Common conversational filler words to ignore in queries
const STOP_WORDS = new Set([
  "how", "do", "i", "can", "we", "the", "a", "an", "is", "are", 
  "to", "for", "of", "in", "on", "what", "where", "when", "why", 
  "who", "which", "my", "our", "it", "with", "about", "at", "by", 
  "or", "and", "from", "be", "get", "need", "want"
]);

// Fast Levenshtein distance algorithm for typo tolerance
function getEditDistance(a, b) {
  if (a.length === 0) return b.length;
  if (b.length === 0) return a.length;

  const matrix = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= b.length; i++) matrix[i] = [i];
  for (let j = 0; j <= a.length; j++) matrix[0][j] = j;

  for (let i = 1; i <= b.length; i++) {
    for (let j = 1; j <= a.length; j++) {
      if (b.charAt(i - 1) === a.charAt(j - 1)) {
        matrix[i][j] = matrix[i - 1][j - 1];
      } else {
        matrix[i][j] = Math.min(
          matrix[i - 1][j - 1] + 1, // substitution
          matrix[i][j - 1] + 1,     // insertion
          matrix[i - 1][j] + 1      // deletion
        );
      }
    }
  }
  return matrix[b.length][a.length];
}

// Determines if two words are a fuzzy match (allows 1-2 typos based on word length)
function isFuzzyMatch(word, target) {
  if (target.includes(word) || word.includes(target)) return true;
  if (word.length <= 3) return word === target;
  
  const maxDistance = word.length >= 6 ? 2 : 1;
  return getEditDistance(word, target) <= maxDistance;
}

/**
 * Intelligent weighted search algorithm
 * @param {string} rawQuery - The user's input
 * @param {Array} articles - The helpArticles array
 * @returns {Array} - Ranked and filtered results
 */
export function searchHelpArticles(rawQuery, articles) {
  if (!rawQuery || !rawQuery.trim()) {
    return articles;
  }

  const cleanQuery = rawQuery.toLowerCase().trim();

  // 1. Tokenize query into meaningful search words
  const rawTokens = cleanQuery.replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, " ").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const meaningfulTokens = rawTokens.filter((token) => !STOP_WORDS.has(token));
  const searchTokens = meaningfulTokens.length > 0 ? meaningfulTokens : rawTokens;

  // 2. Score each article based on weighted relevance
  const scoredArticles = articles.map((article) => {
    let score = 0;
    const titleLower = article.title.toLowerCase();
    const answerLower = article.answer.toLowerCase();
    const categoryLower = article.category.toLowerCase();
    const keywordsLower = article.keywords.map((k) => k.toLowerCase());

    // Exact full query match bonuses
    if (titleLower.includes(cleanQuery)) score += 50;
    if (keywordsLower.some((k) => k.includes(cleanQuery))) score += 40;
    if (answerLower.includes(cleanQuery)) score += 15;

    // Token-by-token matching
    searchTokens.forEach((token) => {
      // Title match (Weight: 15)
      if (titleLower.includes(token)) {
        score += 15;
      } else if (titleLower.split(/\s+/).some((w) => isFuzzyMatch(token, w))) {
        score += 8; // Fuzzy title match
      }

      // Keyword match (Weight: 20)
      if (keywordsLower.some((k) => k === token)) {
        score += 20;
      } else if (keywordsLower.some((k) => k.includes(token))) {
        score += 12;
      } else if (keywordsLower.some((k) => isFuzzyMatch(token, k))) {
        score += 7; // Fuzzy keyword match
      }

      // Category match (Weight: 8)
      if (categoryLower.includes(token)) {
        score += 8;
      }

      // Answer body match (Weight: 4)
      if (answerLower.includes(token)) {
        score += 4;
      }
    });

    return { article, score };
  });

  // 3. Filter out non-matching articles & sort by highest score first
  return scoredArticles
    .filter((item) => item.score > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
    .map((item) => item.article);
}

# React + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend using TypeScript with type-aware lint rules enabled. Check out the [TS template](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/tree/main/packages/create-vite/template-react-ts) for information on how to integrate TypeScript and [`typescript-eslint`](https://typescript-eslint.io) in your project.

// src/cms/pages/Dashboard.jsx
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  getPublications,
  resetPublications,
  LS_PUBLICATIONS_EVENT,
} from "../services/mockData";

export default function CMSDashboard() {
  const [pubCount, setPubCount] = useState(() => getPublications().length);

  // Keep the "Published Notices" count in sync with publish / delete / reset
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => setPubCount(getPublications().length);
    window.addEventListener(LS_PUBLICATIONS_EVENT, update);
    window.addEventListener("storage", update);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(LS_PUBLICATIONS_EVENT, update);
      window.removeEventListener("storage", update);
    };
  }, []);

  const stats = [
    { label: "Pending Complaints", value: "12", color: "#EF4444", icon: "📝" },
    { label: "Published Notices", value: String(pubCount), color: "#10B981", icon: "📰" },
    { label: "Active Projects", value: "24", color: "#FCD116", icon: "🏗️" },
    { label: "Debarred Contractors", value: "3", color: "#001F3F", icon: "⚖️" },
  ];

  const handleResetDemo = () => {
    if (
      window.confirm(
        "This will remove everything published from the CMS and restore the website to its original content. Continue?"
      )
    ) {
      // Clears the CMS data and notifies the website. No page reload needed.
      resetPublications();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: "24px" }}>
        <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "24px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A" }}>Dashboard Overview</h1>

        {/* THE MAGIC BUTTON */}
        <button
          onClick={handleResetDemo}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: "#FEF2F2", color: "#B91C1C", border: "1px solid #FECACA",
            padding: "10px 20px", borderRadius: "8px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700",
            cursor: "pointer", transition: "all 0.2s"
          }}
        >
          Reset Demo Data
        </button>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr))", gap: "24px", marginBottom: "40px" }}>
        {stats.map((stat, index) => (
          <div key={index} style={{ backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", padding: "24px", borderRadius: "12px", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0", boxShadow: "0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.02)" }}>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
              <div>
                <p style={{ margin: "0 0 8px 0", fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase" }}>{stat.label}</p>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "32px", fontWeight: "900", color: stat.color }}>{stat.value}</h3>
              </div>
              <span style={{ fontSize: "24px" }}>{stat.icon}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", padding: "32px", borderRadius: "12px", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0" }}>
        <h2 style={{ margin: "0 0 16px 0", fontSize: "18px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A" }}>Recent Activity</h2>
        <p style={{ color: "#64748B", fontSize: "14px" }}>Activity feed coming soon...</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// src/cms/services/mockData.js

// ORIGINAL website content. This is exactly what the public site shows
// before anything is published from the CMS, and what Reset restores.
export const initialPublications = [
  {
    id: "pub-1",
    date: "May 11, 2026",
    tag: "PRESIDENTIAL ASSENT",
    title: "Value for Money Office Act, 2026 (Act 1172) Becomes Law",
    desc: "The President of the Republic of Ghana has formally assented to the Value for Money Office Act, 2026 (Act 1172), establishing the Office as an independent statutory body corporate. This landmark legislation empowers the Office to enforce strict cost benchmarking across all public sector projects.",
    image: "/utilisation-bg.jpg",
  },
  {
    id: "pub-2",
    date: "May 11, 2026",
    tag: "MINISTERIAL DIRECTIVE",
    title: "Interim Monetary Thresholds for Mandatory VFMO Assessments",
    desc: "Pursuant to Section 30(2) of Act 1172, the Minister for Finance, on the advice of the Board, will prescribe interim monetary thresholds for public sector projects. Any project exceeding these thresholds must undergo a mandatory pre-award assessment.",
    image: "/boardroom.jpg",
  },
  {
    id: "pub-3",
    date: "May 11, 2026",
    tag: "INSTITUTIONAL NOTICE",
    title: "Establishment of Value for Money Units in Covered Entities",
    desc: "All covered entities are required to establish internal Value for Money Units over a five-year phased implementation. These units will prioritise infrastructure, education, and health sectors, ensuring internal compliance before contracts reach the national Office. (Section 28)",
    image: "/about-bg.jpg",
  },
];

export const categories = [
  "PRESIDENTIAL ASSENT",
  "MINISTERIAL DIRECTIVE",
  "INSTITUTIONAL NOTICE",
  "ANNUAL REVIEW",
  "PRESS RELEASE",
];

// Shared localStorage keys: import these everywhere to avoid typos
export const LS_PUBLICATIONS_KEY = "vfmo_publications";
export const LS_PUBLICATIONS_EVENT = "vfmo_publications_changed";

// ---- Helpers: the ONLY code that should touch localStorage ----

// No saved key = the original website. Anything saved = CMS changes.
export function getPublications() {
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(LS_PUBLICATIONS_KEY);
    if (saved === null) return initialPublications;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : initialPublications;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to read publications", e);
    return initialPublications;
  }
}

// Throws if storage is full, so the caller can show an error
export function savePublications(list) {
  localStorage.setItem(LS_PUBLICATIONS_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(LS_PUBLICATIONS_EVENT));
}

// Removes all CMS changes and tells the website to go back to the original
export function resetPublications() {
  localStorage.removeItem(LS_PUBLICATIONS_KEY);
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(LS_PUBLICATIONS_EVENT));
}

File: src/components/ScrollToTop.jsx

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";

export default function ScrollToTop() {
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
  const { pathname } = useLocation();

  // 1. Force scroll to top when the page (URL path) changes
  useEffect(() => {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  }, [pathname]);

  // 2. Show floating button when scrolled down
  useEffect(() => {
    const toggleVisibility = () => {
      if (window.scrollY > 300) {
        setIsVisible(true);
      } else {
        setIsVisible(false);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("scroll", toggleVisibility);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", toggleVisibility);
  }, []);

  // 3. Scroll to top smoothly when the floating button is clicked
  const scrollToTop = () => {
    window.scrollTo({
      top: 0,
      behavior: "smooth"
    });
  };

  return (
    <>
      {isVisible && (
        <button
          onClick={scrollToTop}
          title="Back to Top"
          style={{
            position: "fixed",
            bottom: "32px",
            right: "32px",
            width: "48px",
            height: "48px",
            borderRadius: "50%",
            backgroundColor: "#FCD116",
            color: "#001F3F",
            border: "none",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            cursor: "pointer",
            boxShadow: "0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
            zIndex: 9999,
            transition: "all 0.3s ease",
            animation: "fadeIn 0.3s ease-out forwards"
          }}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => {
            e.currentTarget.style.transform = "translateY(-4px)";
            e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = "0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
          }}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => {
            e.currentTarget.style.transform = "translateY(0)";
            e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = "0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)";
          }}
        >
          <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="5"></line>
            <polyline points="5 12 12 5 19 12"></polyline>
          </svg>
          
          <style>
            {`
              @keyframes fadeIn {
                from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
                to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
              }
              @media (max-width: 768px) {
                button {
                  bottom: 24px !important;
                  right: 24px !important;
                  width: 44px !important;
                  height: 44px !important;
                }
              }
            `}
          </style>
        </button>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

                  padding: "36px 30px", 
                  borderRadius: "16px", 
                  boxShadow: "0 10px 30px -5px rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.05)", 
                  border: "1px solid #E2E8F0",
                  height: "100%",
                  display: "flex",
                  flexDirection: "column",
                  cursor: "pointer",
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ 
                  width: "64px", 
                  height: "64px", 
                  borderRadius: "14px", 
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.04)", 
                  display: "flex", 
                  alignItems: "center", 
                  justifyContent: "center", 
                  marginBottom: "20px",
                  border: "1px solid rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.06)"
                }}>
                  <Icon />
                </div>

                <h3 style={{ fontSize: "20px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#001F3F", margin: "0 0 12px 0", letterSpacing: "-0.3px" }}>
                  {item.title}
                </h3>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "15px", color: "#475569", lineHeight: "1.65", margin: 0, flex: 1, fontWeight: "400" }}>
                  {item.desc}
                </p>
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Portal Button */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }}
          whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          viewport={{ once: false, amount: 0.3 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.6, delay: 0.2 }}
          style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: "55px" }}
        >
          <Link 
            to="/portal" 
            style={{ 
              display: "inline-flex", 
              alignItems: "center", 
              gap: "10px", 
              backgroundColor: "#001F3F", 
              color: "#FFFFFF", 
              padding: "16px 36px", 
              borderRadius: "6px", 
              fontSize: "15px", 
              fontWeight: "800", 
              textDecoration: "none",
              boxShadow: "0 4px 15px rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.15)",
              transition: "transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease",
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => {
              e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = "#0A2E4D";
              e.currentTarget.style.transform = "translateY(-2px)";
            }}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => {
              e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = "#001F3F";
              e.currentTarget.style.transform = "translateY(0)";
            }}
          >
            Access the VFMO Digital Portal to Apply
            <svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5">
              <line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"></line>
              <polyline points="12 5 19 12 12 19"></polyline>
            </svg>
          </Link>
        </motion.div>
      </section>

      {/* 6. PUBLIC REGISTER */}
      <section style={{ position: "relative", padding: "80px 24px 110px", backgroundColor: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)", backdropFilter: "blur(8px)", borderTop: "1px solid #E2E8F0", zIndex: 1 }}>
        <div style={{ maxWidth: "1200px", margin: "0 auto" }}>
          
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 35 }}
            whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            viewport={{ once: false, amount: 0.2 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.7 }}
            style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-end", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "24px", marginBottom: "32px" }}
          >
            <div>
              <span style={{ fontSize: "11px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#8B7355", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "1px", display: "block", marginBottom: "4px" }}>
                Transparency Record
              </span>
              <h2 style={{ fontSize: "32px", fontWeight: "900", color: "#0F172A", margin: "0 0 6px 0", letterSpacing: "-0.5px" }}>
                Public Register of Issued Certificates
              </h2>
              <p style={{ color: "#475569", fontSize: "15px", margin: 0 }}>
                Published in accordance with Section 27(4)(d) of Act 1172.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Live Filter Input */}
            <div style={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", maxWidth: "320px" }}>
              <input 
                type="text" 
                placeholder="Search by ID, project or entity..." 
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                style={{ 
                  width: "100%",

                <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle>
                <line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line>
              </svg>
            </div>
          </motion.div>

          {/* Table with Rising Reveal */}
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 50 }}
            whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            viewport={{ once: false, amount: 0.15 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
            style={{ overflowX: "auto", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0", borderRadius: "14px", boxShadow: "0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.03)", backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF" }}
          >
            <table style={{ width: "100%", borderCollapse: "collapse", textAlign: "left", minWidth: "800px" }}>
              <thead>
                <tr style={{ backgroundColor: "#F8FAFC", borderBottom: "1px solid #E2E8F0" }}>
                  <th style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.5px" }}>Certificate ID</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.5px" }}>Project Name</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.5px" }}>Covered Entity</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.5px" }}>Value</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.5px" }}>Date Issued</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.5px" }}>Status</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {filteredCertificates.length > 0 ? (
                  filteredCertificates.map((cert, index) => (
                    <tr 
                      key={index} 
                      style={{ borderBottom: "1px solid #F1F5F9", transition: "background-color 0.15s ease" }}
                      onMouseEnter={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = "#F8FAFC")}
                      onMouseLeave={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = "transparent")}
                    >
                      <td style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#001F3F" }}>{cert.id}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "600", color: "#0F172A" }}>{cert.project}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "14px", color: "#475569" }}>{cert.entity}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A" }}>{cert.value}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: "16px 24px", fontSize: "14px", color: "#64748B" }}>{cert.date}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: "16px 24px" }}>
                        <span style={{ display: "inline-block", padding: "5px 12px", borderRadius: "20px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "800", backgroundColor: "#D1FAE5", color: "#065F46" }}>
                          {cert.status}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan="6" style={{ padding: "40px", textAlign: "center", color: "#64748B", fontSize: "14px" }}>
                      No certificates found matching your search.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      </section>

    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";

export default function Engagement() {
  const [feedbackSubmitted, setFeedbackSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = useState(null);
  const [isRegistered, setIsRegistered] = useState(false);

  const handleFeedbackSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFeedbackSubmitted(true);
  };

  const handleRegistrationSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsRegistered(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setIsRegistered(false);
    }, 3000);
  };

  const upcomingHearings = [
    {
      title: "Public Hearing: Tema Interchange Phase 2",
      date: "November 15, 2026",
      time: "10:00 AM - 1:00 PM",
      location: "Tema Community Center, Greater Accra",
      status: "Registration Open"
    },
    {
      title: "Stakeholder Forum: Regional Hospital Equipment",
      date: "November 22, 2026",
      time: "9:00 AM - 12:00 PM",
      location: "Ghana Health Service Auditorium, Accra",
      status: "Registration Open"
    },
    {
      title: "Public Consultation: STEM School Construction",
      date: "December 05, 2026",
      time: "2:00 PM - 5:00 PM",
      location: "Ministry of Education Conference Hall, Accra",
      status: "Save the Date"
    }
  ];

  const pastMeetings = [
    {
      title: "Public Hearing: Pipeline Expansion Project",
      date: "October 10, 2026",
      keyIssues: "Community concerns regarding environmental impact and water supply disruption.",
      officeResponse: "The VfM Office mandated a revised Environmental Impact Assessment before approving the contract. The contractor must now provide a water restoration plan."
    },
    {
      title: "Stakeholder Meeting: School Furniture Procurement",
      date: "September 18, 2026",
      keyIssues: "Suppliers raised concerns about delayed payments and unclear quality specifications.",
      officeResponse: "Clear quality standards were published, and the Ministry of Education was directed to streamline payment processes for verified deliveries."
    }

  return (
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#F8F9FA", minHeight: "100vh", overflowX: "hidden" }}>

            align-items: center !important;
            white-space: nowrap !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
          }
          @media (min-width: 768px) {
            .action-btn-fix {
              width: auto !important;
              display: inline-flex !important;
            }
          }
        `}
      </style>

      {/* 1. HERO SECTION */}
      <section style={{ position: "relative", backgroundColor: "#001F3F", padding: "100px 24px", textAlign: "center", overflow: "hidden" }}>
        <div style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, backgroundImage: "url(/building-bg.jpg)", backgroundSize: "cover", backgroundPosition: "center", opacity: 0.2, zIndex: 0 }} />
        <div style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, background: "linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,31,63,0.8) 0%, rgba(0,31,63,1) 100%)", zIndex: 1 }} />
        
        <div style={{ maxWidth: "900px", margin: "0 auto", position: "relative", zIndex: 2 }}>
          <h1 style={{ fontSize: "52px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#FFFFFF", margin: "0 0 24px 0", lineHeight: "1.1" }}>
            Public Engagement & Fora
          </h1>
          <p style={{ fontSize: "20px", color: "#CBD5E1", lineHeight: "1.6", margin: 0, maxWidth: "700px", marginLeft: "auto", marginRight: "auto" }}>
            Ensuring that the voices of citizens and stakeholders are heard in the evaluation of major public projects (Section 43).
          </p>
        </div>

      <section style={{ padding: "80px 24px", maxWidth: "1200px", margin: "0 auto" }}>

                  {hearing.status === "Registration Open" ? "Register to Attend" : "Details Coming Soon"}

        </div>

                  <div>

                  </div>

                  </button>
                </form>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { motion, useScroll, useTransform, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";

// ========================================================
// 1. HAND-DRAWN ICONS FOR PENALTIES (Warning Red Theme)
// ========================================================
const HandDrawnSuspension = () => (
  <svg width="44" height="44" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="#991B1B" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    <circle cx="24" cy="24" r="17" strokeWidth="2.6" />
    <path d="M15 15 L33 33" strokeWidth="3" />
    <path d="M33 15 L15 33" strokeWidth="3" />
    <circle cx="24" cy="24" r="13" strokeWidth="1.4" strokeDasharray="3 3" opacity="0.4" />
  </svg>
);

const HandDrawnDebarment = () => (
  <svg width="44" height="44" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="#991B1B" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    <path d="M12 6 C12 4.5, 13.5 4, 15 4 L33 4 L40 11 L40 42 C40 43.5, 38.5 44, 37 44 L15 44 C13.5 44, 12 43.5, 12 42 Z" />
    <path d="M30 4 L30 14 L40 14" />
    <path d="M20 20 L32 32" strokeWidth="3" />
    <path d="M32 20 L20 32" strokeWidth="3" />
  </svg>
);

const HandDrawnRecovery = () => (
  <svg width="44" height="44" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="#991B1B" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    <path d="M6 40 L42 40" strokeWidth="2.5" />
    <path d="M6 40 L6 8" strokeWidth="2.5" />
    <path d="M10 28 L20 18 L28 24 L40 12" strokeWidth="2.8" />
    <path d="M30 12 L40 12 L40 22" strokeWidth="2.8" />
    <circle cx="24" cy="34" r="4" fill="rgba(153,27,27,0.1)" strokeWidth="2" />
  </svg>
);

// ========================================================
// 2. REVEAL HELPERS (Work on all screen sizes)
// ========================================================

const Reveal = ({ children, delay = 0, y = 40, once = true }) => {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);
  const prefersReduced = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          if (once) observer.unobserve(el);
        } else if (!once) {
          setInView(false);
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: "0px 0px -60px 0px" }
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [once]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      style={{
        opacity: prefersReduced ? 1 : inView ? 1 : 0,
        transform: prefersReduced
          ? "none"
          : inView
          ? "translateY(0)"
          : `translateY(${y}px)`,
        transition: `opacity 0.8s ease-out ${delay}s, transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) ${delay}s`,
        willChange: "opacity, transform",
        width: "100%",
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
};

const RevealText = ({ text, as: Tag = "span", style = {}, delay = 0, wordDelay = 0.06 }) => {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);
  const prefersReduced = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          observer.unobserve(el);
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.2 }
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const words = String(text).split(" ");

  return (
    <Tag ref={ref} style={{ ...style, display: "inline" }}>
      {words.map((word, i) => (
        <span key={i} style={{ display: "inline-block", overflow: "hidden", verticalAlign: "top" }}>
          <motion.span
            initial={prefersReduced ? { y: 0, opacity: 1 } : { y: "110%", opacity: 0 }}
            animate={inView ? { y: 0, opacity: 1 } : prefersReduced ? { y: 0, opacity: 1 } : { y: "110%", opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], delay: delay + i * wordDelay }}
            style={{ display: "inline-block", willChange: "transform" }}
          >
            {word}
          </motion.span>
          {i < words.length - 1 && <span>&nbsp;</span>}
        </span>
      ))}
    </Tag>
  );
};

// ========================================================
// 3. MAIN PAGE
// ========================================================

export default function Sanctions() {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const prefersReduced = useReducedMotion();

  const heroRef = useRef(null);
  const { scrollYProgress } = useScroll({
    target: heroRef,
    offset: ["start start", "end start"],
  });
  const heroBgY = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], ["0%", "25%"]);
  const heroContentY = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], [0, 80]);
  const heroOpacity = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 0.9], [1, 0]);
  const heroScale = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], [1, 1.08]);

  const debarredContractors = [
    { name: "Apex Construction Ltd.", regNo: "CS-49201", reason: "Contract Price Inflation", date: "Jan 15, 2026", expiry: "Jan 15, 2029", status: "Active Ban" },
    { name: "Delta Roads & Infrastructure", regNo: "CS-88123", reason: "Breach of Quality Standards", date: "Mar 10, 2026", expiry: "Mar 10, 2028", status: "Active Ban" },
    { name: "Omega Medical Supplies", regNo: "CS-11045", reason: "Cost Irregularity / Waste", date: "Nov 05, 2025", expiry: "Nov 05, 2027", status: "Active Ban" },
  ];

  const filteredContractors = debarredContractors.filter(
    (contractor) =>
      contractor.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      contractor.regNo.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
  );

  const penalties = [
    { 
      title: "Suspension", 
      desc: "Immediate suspension of the contractor from ongoing public procurement processes under the Public Procurement Act, 2003 (Act 663).",
      icon: HandDrawnSuspension
    },
    { 
      title: "Debarment", 
      desc: "A formal ban from participating in any future government contracts for a period of not less than two (2) years and not more than five (5) years.",
      icon: HandDrawnDebarment
    },
    { 
      title: "Civil Recovery", 
      desc: "The Office will initiate civil recovery proceedings to retrieve overpayments and unjustified costs from the contractor or supplier.",
      icon: HandDrawnRecovery
    }
  ];

  return (
    <div style={{ position: "relative", backgroundColor: "#F8F9FA", minHeight: "100vh", overflowX: "hidden" }}>
      
      {/* FULL-PAGE SUBTLE VFMO LOGO BACKGROUND */}
      <div

        style={{
          position: "fixed",
          inset: 0,
          zIndex: 0,
          pointerEvents: "none",
          backgroundImage: "url(/vfm-logo.png)",
          backgroundRepeat: "no-repeat",
          backgroundPosition: "center center",
          backgroundSize: "min(85vw, 900px)",
          opacity: 0.05,
          filter: "grayscale(10%)",
        }}
      />

      {/* ALL CONTENT ABOVE LOGO */}
      <div style={{ position: "relative", zIndex: 1 }}>

        {/* 1. HERO SECTION */}
        <section
          ref={heroRef}
          style={{
            position: "relative",
            backgroundColor: "#001F3F",
            padding: "120px 24px 110px",
            textAlign: "center",
            overflow: "hidden",
          }}
        >
          <motion.div
            style={{
              position: "absolute",
              top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: "-15%",
              backgroundImage: "url(/building-bg.jpg)",
              backgroundSize: "cover",
              backgroundPosition: "center",
              opacity: 0.2,
              zIndex: 0,
              y: prefersReduced ? 0 : heroBgY,
              scale: prefersReduced ? 1 : heroScale,
            }}
          />
          <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, background: "linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,31,63,0.8) 0%, rgba(0,31,63,1) 100%)", zIndex: 1 }} />

                              viewport={{ once: true }}
                              transition={{ duration: 0.4, delay: 0.2 + index * 0.1 }}
                              style={{ display: "inline-block", padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: "20px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "700", backgroundColor: "#FEE2E2", color: "#991B1B" }}
                            >
                              {contractor.status}
                            </motion.span>
                          </td>
                        </motion.tr>
                      ))
                    ) : (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan="6" style={{ padding: "32px", textAlign: "center", color: "#64748B" }}>
                          No debarred contractors found matching your search.
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </Reveal>

            <Reveal delay={0.15}>
              <p style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#64748B", marginTop: "16px", fontStyle: "italic" }}>
                *If you suspect a covered entity is engaging a debarred contractor, please report it immediately via our{" "}
                <a href="/submit" style={{ color: "#001F3F", fontWeight: "600" }}>Whistleblower Portal</a>.
              </p>
            </Reveal>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ========================================================
// 2. REVEAL HELPERS
// ========================================================
const Reveal = ({ children, delay = 0, y = 40, once = true }) => {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);
  const prefersReduced = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          if (once) observer.unobserve(el);
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: "0px 0px -60px 0px" }
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [once]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      style={{
        opacity: prefersReduced ? 1 : inView ? 1 : 0,
        transform: prefersReduced ? "none" : inView ? "translateY(0)" : `translateY(${y}px)`,
        transition: `opacity 0.8s ease-out ${delay}s, transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) ${delay}s`,
        willChange: "opacity, transform",
        width: "100%",
        height: "100%"
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
};

const RevealText = ({ text, as: Tag = "span", style = {}, delay = 0, wordDelay = 0.05 }) => {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);
  const prefersReduced = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          observer.unobserve(el);
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.2 }
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const words = String(text).split(" ");

  return (
    <Tag ref={ref} style={{ ...style, display: "inline" }}>
      {words.map((word, i) => (
        <span key={i} style={{ display: "inline-block", overflow: "hidden", verticalAlign: "top" }}>
          <motion.span
            initial={prefersReduced ? { y: 0, opacity: 1 } : { y: "110%", opacity: 0 }}
            animate={inView ? { y: 0, opacity: 1 } : prefersReduced ? { y: 0, opacity: 1 } : { y: "110%", opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], delay: delay + i * wordDelay }}
            style={{ display: "inline-block", willChange: "transform" }}
          >
            {word}
          </motion.span>
          {i < words.length - 1 && <span>&nbsp;</span>}
        </span>
      ))}
    </Tag>
  );
};

                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* 3. PUBLISHED SUMMARIES */}

                  <RevealText text="Published in accordance with Section 27(4)(a) of Act 1172." delay={0.15} wordDelay={0.02} />
                </p>
              </div>
            </Reveal>

            <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "32px" }}>
              {publishedSummaries.map((summary, index) => (
                <motion.div 
                  key={index}
                  initial={prefersReduced ? { opacity: 1, y: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 40 }}
                  whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  viewport={{ once: true, amount: 0.15 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], delay: index * 0.15 }}

                  <motion.div 
                    whileHover={prefersReduced ? {} : { backgroundColor: "#F1F5F9", borderColor: "#CBD5E1", boxShadow: "0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0,31,63,0.08)" }}

                      transition: "background-color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease"

                      <div>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#001F3F", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "1px", display: "block", marginBottom: "6px" }}>
                          {summary.entity}
                        </span>
                        <h3 style={{ fontSize: "22px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A", margin: 0, lineHeight: "1.3" }}>
                          {summary.title}

                      <div style={{ textAlign: "right", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "flex-end", gap: "6px" }}>

                </motion.div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* 4. LIVE STATUS TRACKER */}
        <section style={{ padding: "80px 24px", maxWidth: "1200px", margin: "0 auto" }}>

                <p style={{ color: "#475569", fontSize: "17px", margin: 0 }}>

                </p>
              </div>
              <motion.div
                initial={prefersReduced ? { opacity: 1 } : { opacity: 0, x: 30 }}
                whileInView={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
