export default function ReviewPanel() {
  const [fileName, setFileName] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitted, setIsSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [trackingCode, setTrackingCode] = useState("");
  const [isFormOpen, setIsFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const prefersReduced = useReducedMotion();

  const handleFileChange = (e) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      setFileName(e.target.files[0].name);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const randomNum = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
    setTrackingCode(`VFM-RV-2026-${randomNum}`);
    setIsSubmitted(true);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  const processSteps = [
    {
      title: "Draft Your Grounds",
      desc: "Set out the decision you are complaining about and the grounds for your dissatisfaction. Attach any relevant documents or information you intend to rely on (Section 50(2)).",
      icon: HandDrawnDraft
    },
    {
      title: "Complete Online Form",
      desc: "Fill out the official Review Application Form below. You can upload all your supporting documents directly into the portal.",
      icon: HandDrawnComplete
    },
    {
      title: "Submit Application",
      desc: "Hit submit, and your application will be securely sent to the Secretary of the Review Panel with a tracking code.",
      icon: HandDrawnSubmit
    }
  ];

  const panelMembers = [
    { title: "Chairperson", desc: "A retired Justice of the Superior Court of Judicature or a lawyer with at least 15 years' experience in administrative law and public financial management.", icon: HandDrawnGavel },
    { title: "Legal Expert", desc: "A legal practitioner of not less than 10 years' standing with expertise in administrative law and the Public Financial Management Act, 2016 (Act 921).", icon: HandDrawnLegal },
    { title: "Financial Management Expert", desc: "An expert with demonstrable knowledge in the application of the Public Financial Management Act, 2016 (Act 921) and its Regulations.", icon: HandDrawnFinance },
    { title: "Procurement Expert", desc: "An expert in public procurement or value for money practice with knowledge of the Public Procurement Act, 2003 (Act 663).", icon: HandDrawnProcurement },
    { title: "Governance & Audit Expert", desc: "An expert in governance, audit, risk management, or public sector oversight from a relevant professional body.", icon: HandDrawnAudit }
  ];

  return (
    <div style={{ position: "relative", backgroundColor: "#F8F9FA", minHeight: "100vh", overflowX: "hidden" }}>

          backgroundPosition: "center center", backgroundSize: "min(85vw, 900px)",
          opacity: 0.04, filter: "grayscale(10%)",
        }}
      />

      <div style={{ position: "relative", zIndex: 1 }}>
        
        {/* 1. HERO SECTION */}
        <section style={{ position: "relative", backgroundColor: "#001F3F", padding: "100px 24px", textAlign: "center", overflow: "hidden" }}>
          <div style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, backgroundImage: "url(/building-bg.jpg)", backgroundSize: "cover", backgroundPosition: "center", opacity: 0.2, zIndex: 0 }} />
          <div style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, background: "linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,31,63,0.8) 0%, rgba(0,31,63,1) 100%)", zIndex: 1 }} />
          
          <div style={{ maxWidth: "900px", margin: "0 auto", position: "relative", zIndex: 2 }}>
            <h1 style={{ fontSize: "clamp(36px, 5vw, 52px)", fontWeight: "800", color: "#FFFFFF", margin: "0 0 24px 0", lineHeight: "1.1" }}>
              Value for Money Review Panel
            </h1>
            <p style={{ fontSize: "clamp(16px, 2vw, 20px)", color: "#CBD5E1", lineHeight: "1.6", margin: 0, maxWidth: "700px", marginLeft: "auto", marginRight: "auto" }}>
              An independent body established under Section 49 of Act 1172 to hear appeals against decisions made by the VfM Office.
            </p>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* 2. RIGHT OF APPEAL & 14-DAY WARNING */}
        <section style={{ padding: "60px 24px 20px", maxWidth: "1000px", margin: "0 auto" }}>
          <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#FFF7ED", border: "2px solid #F97316", borderRadius: "12px", padding: "32px", display: "flex", gap: "20px", alignItems: "flex-start", boxShadow: "0 10px 20px rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.1)" }}>
            <div style={{ width: "48px", height: "48px", backgroundColor: "#FFEDD5", borderRadius: "50%", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", flexShrink: 0 }}>
              <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#EA580C" strokeWidth="2.5"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12"></line><line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16"></line></svg>
            </div>

                Pursuant to <strong>Section 50(1) of Act 1172</strong>, any person or covered entity aggrieved by a decision of the VfM Office must apply to the Review Panel within <strong>fourteen (14) days</strong> after receiving the notice of the decision. 
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* 3. HOW TO APPLY (Borderless List with Icons) */}
        <section style={{ padding: "80px 24px", maxWidth: "1200px", margin: "0 auto" }}>
          <div style={{ textAlign: "center", marginBottom: "60px" }}>
            <h2 style={{ fontSize: "clamp(28px, 4vw, 36px)", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A", margin: "0 0 16px 0" }}>Application Process</h2>
            <p style={{ color: "#475569", fontSize: "18px", margin: 0 }}>Follow these steps to file an application for review.</p>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr))", gap: "60px 48px", marginBottom: "60px" }}>

              const IconComponent = step.icon;
              return (

                    {step.desc}
                  </p>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* CTA Button to Reveal Form */}
          <motion.div 
            initial={prefersReduced ? { opacity: 1 } : { opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            viewport={{ once: true }}
            style={{ textAlign: "center" }}
          >
            <button 
              onClick={() => setIsFormOpen(!isFormOpen)} 
              style={{ 
                display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", gap: "12px",
                backgroundColor: "#001F3F", color: "#FFFFFF", padding: "16px 32px", borderRadius: "8px",

              onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = "#001F3F"}
            >
              {isFormOpen ? "Hide Application Form" : "Begin Review Application"}
              <motion.div
                animate={{ y: isFormOpen ? -4 : 4, rotate: isFormOpen ? 180 : 0 }}

              </motion.div>
            </button>
          </motion.div>
        </section>

        {/* 4. THE ONLINE APPLICATION FORM (Animated Reveal) */}
        <AnimatePresence>
          {isFormOpen && (
            <motion.section 
              id="application-form" 
              initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}

              exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}

                {isSubmitted ? (
                  /* SUCCESS STATE */
                  <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: "20px 0" }}>
                    <div style={{ width: "80px", height: "80px", backgroundColor: "#F0FDF4", borderRadius: "50%", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", margin: "0 auto 24px auto" }}>
                      <svg width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#10B981" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"></path><polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"></polyline></svg>
                    </div>
                    <h2 style={{ fontSize: "28px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A", marginBottom: "16px" }}>Application Received</h2>

                    </p>
                    
                    <button

                      style={{ display: "inline-flex", padding: "14px 32px", backgroundColor: "#001F3F", color: "#FFFFFF", borderRadius: "8px", fontSize: "16px", fontWeight: "700", textDecoration: "none", border: "none", cursor: "pointer" }}
                    >

                ) : (
                  /* FORM STATE */

                      <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#001F3F" strokeWidth="2" style={{ flexShrink: 0, marginTop: "2px" }}><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12" y2="12"></line><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12.01" y2="8"></line></svg>
                      <div>
                        <h4 style={{ margin: "0 0 4px 0", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#001F3F" }}>Statutory Timeline Notice</h4>

              </p>
            </div>

                return (
                  <motion.div
                    key={index}
                    initial={prefersReduced ? { opacity: 1, y: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 30 }}
                    whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    viewport={{ once: true }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.6, delay: index * 0.1 }}
                    style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}
                  >
                    <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "16px", marginBottom: "16px" }}>
                      <div style={{ flexShrink: 0, width: "48px", height: "48px", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}>
                        <IconComponent />
                      </div>
                      <h3 style={{ fontSize: "19px", fontWeight: "900", color: "#001F3F", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.5px", lineHeight: "1.25", margin: 0 }}>

                      </h3>
                    </div>
                    <p style={{ fontSize: "15px", color: "#475569", lineHeight: "1.65", margin: 0 }}>
                      {member.desc}
                    </p>
                  </motion.div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

          </div>
        </section>

        {/* 6. HEARING PROCESS */}
        <section style={{ padding: "80px 24px", maxWidth: "900px", margin: "0 auto" }}>
          <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#001F3F", borderRadius: "16px", padding: "48px", color: "#FFFFFF", boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)" }}>
            <h2 style={{ fontSize: "28px", fontWeight: "800", margin: "0 0 24px 0" }}>What Happens After You Apply?</h2>
            
            <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "24px" }}>
              <div>
                <h3 style={{ fontSize: "18px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#FCD116", margin: "0 0 8px 0" }}>1. Hearing</h3>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "16px", color: "#CBD5E1", lineHeight: "1.6", margin: 0 }}>
                  Within 30 days of receiving a complete application, the Review Panel will give the VfM Office and any interested party a reasonable opportunity to be heard (Section 51(1)).
                </p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 style={{ fontSize: "18px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#FCD116", margin: "0 0 8px 0" }}>2. Determination</h3>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "16px", color: "#CBD5E1", lineHeight: "1.6", margin: 0 }}>
                  The Panel will then confirm, vary, set aside the decision of the Office, or remit the matter to the Office with directions.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 style={{ fontSize: "18px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#FCD116", margin: "0 0 8px 0" }}>3. Effect of Application</h3>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "16px", color: "#CBD5E1", lineHeight: "1.6", margin: 0 }}>
                  Filing an application does not automatically suspend the decision of the Office. However, the Panel may order a stay of execution if it considers it just and equitable to do so (Section 52).
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";

export default function Contact() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: "",
    email: "",
    department: "General Inquiry",
    message: ""
  });

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    setFormData({ ...formData, [e.target.name]: e.target.value });
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    alert("Thank you. Your message has been routed to the appropriate department.");
    setFormData({ name: "", email: "", department: "General Inquiry", message: "" });
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#F4F5F0", minHeight: "100vh", overflowX: "hidden" }}>
      
      {/* GLOBAL CSS FIX FOR THE BUTTON */}
      <style>
        {`
          .submit-btn-fix {
            width: 100% !important;
            min-width: 100% !important;
            display: block !important;
            padding: 16px 20px !important;
            white-space: nowrap !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            background-color: #001F3F !important;
            color: #FFFFFF !important;
            border: none !important;
            border-radius: 8px !important;
            font-size: 16px !important;
            font-weight: 700 !important;
            cursor: pointer !important;
            margin-top: 8px !important;
          }
          .submit-btn-fix:hover {
            background-color: #0A2E4D !important;
          }
        `}
      </style>

      {/* HEADER SECTION WITH BACKGROUND IMAGE */}
      <section style={{ 
        position: "relative", 
        padding: "100px 24px 80px", 
        backgroundColor: "#001F3F", 
        overflow: "hidden",
        textAlign: "center"
      }}>
        <div style={{
          position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0,
          backgroundImage: "url(/contact-bg.jpg)", 
          backgroundSize: "cover", backgroundPosition: "center",
          opacity: 0.2, zIndex: 0
        }} />
        
        <div style={{
          position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0,

                <input 
                  type="text" name="name" value={formData.name} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="John Doe"
                  style={{ width: "100%", padding: "14px", borderRadius: "8px", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", fontSize: "16px", outline: "none", transition: "border 0.2s", boxSizing: "border-box" }}

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { motion, useScroll, useTransform, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";

// Extracted component for the timeline logic
const TimelineStage = ({ stage, index, totalStages, caseData, timelineProgress, prefersReduced }) => {
  const isCompleted = stage.id < caseData.stage || (caseData.stage === 5 && stage.id === 5);
  const isActive = stage.id === caseData.stage && caseData.stage !== 5;
  const isPending = stage.id > caseData.stage;

  const stageX = useTransform(
    timelineProgress, 
    [0, 0.1 + index * 0.1, 0.2 + index * 0.1], 
    prefersReduced ? [0, 0, 0] : [-30, 0, 0]
  );
  const stageOpacity = useTransform(
    timelineProgress, 
    [0, 0.1 + index * 0.1, 0.2 + index * 0.1], 
    prefersReduced ? [1, 1, 1] : [0, 1, 1]
  );

  return (
    <motion.div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "20px", x: stageX, opacity: stageOpacity }}>
      {/* Timeline Line & Icon */}
      <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center" }}>
        <div style={{ 
          width: "32px", height: "32px", borderRadius: "50%", 
          backgroundColor: isCompleted ? "#10B981" : isActive ? "#FCD116" : "#F1F5F9",
          display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", zIndex: 1, flexShrink: 0
        }}>
          {isCompleted ? (
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="3"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline></svg>
          ) : isActive ? (
            <div style={{ width: "10px", height: "10px", borderRadius: "50%", backgroundColor: "#001F3F" }}></div>
          ) : (
            <div style={{ width: "8px", height: "8px", borderRadius: "50%", backgroundColor: "#CBD5E1" }}></div>
          )}
        </div>
        {index !== totalStages - 1 && (
          <div style={{ width: "2px", flex: 1, backgroundColor: isCompleted ? "#10B981" : "#E2E8F0", minHeight: "60px" }} />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Timeline Content */}
      <div style={{ paddingBottom: "40px", flex: 1 }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-start", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "8px" }}>
          <h3 style={{ fontSize: "18px", fontWeight: "800", color: isPending ? "#94A3B8" : "#0F172A", margin: "0 0 4px 0" }}>{stage.title}</h3>
          <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: "600", color: isActive ? "#B8860B" : isCompleted ? "#10B981" : "#64748B" }}>{stage.date}</span>
        </div>
        <p style={{ fontSize: "15px", color: isPending ? "#CBD5E1" : "#475569", margin: 0, lineHeight: "1.5" }}>{stage.desc}</p>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

export default function Track() {
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const urlCode = searchParams.get("code") || "";
  
  const [trackingCode, setTrackingCode] = useState(urlCode);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(null); 
  const [caseData, setCaseData] = useState(null);
  const prefersReduced = useReducedMotion();

  const handleTrack = (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    setStatus("loading");

    setTimeout(() => {
      if (trackingCode.trim().toUpperCase().startsWith("VFM-WB-")) {
        setCaseData({
          code: trackingCode.toUpperCase(),
          dateSubmitted: "October 20, 2026",
          stage: 3, 
          outcome: null, 
        });
        setStatus("success");
      } else {
        setStatus("error");
      }
    }, 1000);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (urlCode) {
      setTrackingCode(urlCode);
      if (urlCode.trim().toUpperCase().startsWith("VFM-WB-")) {
        setCaseData({
          code: urlCode.toUpperCase(),
          dateSubmitted: "October 20, 2026",
          stage: 3,
          outcome: null,
        });
        setStatus("success");
      }
    }
  }, [urlCode]);

  const containerRef = useRef(null);
  const { scrollYProgress } = useScroll();
  const headerY = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 0.2], [0, -50]);
  const headerOpacity = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 0.2], [1, 0.2]);
  const formY = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 0.3], [0, -30]);
  const formScale = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 0.3], [1, 0.95]);
  const { scrollYProgress: timelineProgress } = useScroll({
    target: containerRef,
    offset: ["start end", "end start"]
  });

  const stages = [
    { id: 1, title: "Report Received", desc: "Your report has been securely logged in our system.", date: "Oct 20, 2026" },
    { id: 2, title: "Acknowledged", desc: "The VfM Office has formally acknowledged your complaint. (Within 7 days)", date: "Oct 25, 2026" },
    { id: 3, title: "Preliminary Assessment", desc: "We are currently reviewing the details to determine if an investigation is warranted. (Within 14 days)", date: "In Progress" },
    { id: 4, title: "Investigation / Referral", desc: "If valid, the case will be investigated or referred to the Auditor-General.", date: "Pending" },
    { id: 5, title: "Case Closed", desc: "The outcome of the assessment has been finalized.", date: "Pending" },
  ];

  const simulateStage2 = () => setCaseData(prev => ({ ...prev, stage: 2, outcome: null }));
  const simulateStage4 = () => setCaseData(prev => ({ ...prev, stage: 4, outcome: null }));
  const simulateFindings = () => setCaseData(prev => ({ ...prev, stage: 5, outcome: "findings" }));
  const simulateDismissed = () => setCaseData(prev => ({ ...prev, stage: 5, outcome: "dismissed" }));
  const resetSimulation = () => setCaseData(prev => ({ ...prev, stage: 3, outcome: null }));

  // --- GENERATE FINDINGS PDF ---
  const generateFindingsPDF = () => {
    const pdfContent = `
      %PDF-1.4
      1 0 obj
      << /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>
      endobj
      2 0 obj
      << /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>
      endobj
      3 0 obj
      << /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>
      endobj
      4 0 obj
      << /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>
      endobj
      5 0 obj
      << /Length 450 >>
      stream
      BT
      /F1 24 Tf
      50 700 Td
      (VALUE FOR MONEY OFFICE) Tj
      0 -30 Td
      (FINAL ASSESSMENT FINDINGS) Tj
      /F1 12 Tf
      0 -40 Td
      (Tracking Code: ${caseData.code}) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (Date Closed: October 26, 2026) Tj
      0 -40 Td
      (Findings Summary:) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (Pursuant to Section 38 of Act 1172, the VFMO has completed its) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (investigation into this report. The contractor was found to have) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (engaged in unjustified cost inflation.) Tj
      0 -30 Td
      (Statutory Action Taken:) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (- The contractor has been debarred for 3 years under Section 38(2)(a).) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (- Civil recovery proceedings initiated for GH 4.2M.) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (- Referred to the Auditor-General for further audit.) Tj
      0 -40 Td
      (This document is automatically generated and is legally binding.) Tj
      ET
      endstream
      endobj
      xref
      0 6
      0000000000 65535 f 
      0000000010 00000 n 
      0000000079 00000 n 
      0000000173 00000 n 
      0000000301 00000 n 
      0000000380 00000 n 
      trailer
      << /Size 6 /Root 1 0 R >>
      startxref
      840
      %%EOF
    `;
    return `data:application/pdf;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(pdfContent)}`;
  };

  // --- GENERATE DISMISSAL PDF ---
  const generateDismissalPDF = () => {
    const pdfContent = `
      %PDF-1.4
      1 0 obj
      << /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>
      endobj
      2 0 obj
      << /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>
      endobj
      3 0 obj
      << /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>
      endobj
      4 0 obj

      stream
      BT

      50 700 Td
      (VALUE FOR MONEY OFFICE) Tj

      /F1 12 Tf

      0 -20 Td
      (Pursuant to Section 46(2) of the Value for Money Office Act,) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (the Office has determined that your complaint is inadmissible) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (or outside the mandate of the Office.) Tj
      0 -30 Td
      (Specifically, the preliminary assessment revealed that:) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (1. The complaint did not provide sufficient evidence of a) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (breach of Value for Money standards.) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (2. The alleged incident occurred outside the statutory) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (mandate of the Office.) Tj
      0 -40 Td
      (You may apply for a review of this decision under Section 50,) Tj
      0 -20 Td
      (within fourteen days of receipt of this notice.) Tj
      ET
      endstream
      endobj
      xref
      0 6
      0000000000 65535 f 
      0000000010 00000 n 
      0000000079 00000 n 
      0000000173 00000 n 
      0000000301 00000 n 
      0000000380 00000 n 
      trailer
      << /Size 6 /Root 1 0 R >>
      startxref
      840
      %%EOF
    `;
    return `data:application/pdf;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(pdfContent)}`;
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ position: "relative", backgroundColor: "#F4F5F0", minHeight: "100vh", padding: "80px 24px", overflowX: "hidden" }}>
      
      <div aria-hidden="true" style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 0, pointerEvents: "none", backgroundImage: "url(/vfm-logo.png)", backgroundRepeat: "no-repeat", backgroundPosition: "center center", backgroundSize: "min(85vw, 900px)", opacity: 0.05, filter: "grayscale(10%)" }} />

      <div style={{ position: "relative", zIndex: 1, maxWidth: "700px", margin: "0 auto" }}>
        
        <motion.div style={{ textAlign: "center", marginBottom: "40px", y: prefersReduced ? 0 : headerY, opacity: prefersReduced ? 1 : headerOpacity }}>
          <div style={{ width: "64px", height: "64px", backgroundColor: "rgba(0,31,63,0.05)", borderRadius: "50%", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", margin: "0 auto 24px auto" }}>
            <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#001F3F" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line></svg>
          </div>
          <h1 style={{ fontSize: "clamp(32px, 5vw, 42px)", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A", margin: "0 0 16px 0", lineHeight: "1.1" }}>
            Track Your Report
          </h1>
          <p style={{ fontSize: "clamp(16px, 2vw, 18px)", color: "#475569", margin: 0, lineHeight: "1.6" }}>
            Enter the tracking code provided when you submitted your complaint to see its current status.
          </p>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div style={{ y: prefersReduced ? 0 : formY, scale: prefersReduced ? 1 : formScale }}>
          <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", borderRadius: "16px", padding: "32px", boxShadow: "0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0", marginBottom: "40px" }}>
            <form onSubmit={handleTrack} style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "16px" }}>
              <div>
                <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#0F172A", marginBottom: "8px" }}>Tracking Code</label>
                <input 
                  type="text" 
                  value={trackingCode}
                  onChange={(e) => setTrackingCode(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g., VFM-WB-2026-4821"
                  required
                  style={{ width: "100%", padding: "16px", borderRadius: "8px", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", fontSize: "16px", fontWeight: "600", outline: "none", textTransform: "uppercase", boxSizing: "border-box" }}
                />
              </div>
            </form>

            <div style={{ display: "block", width: "100%", marginTop: "16px" }}>
              <button 
                type="button"
                onClick={handleTrack}
                style={{ 
                  backgroundColor: "#001F3F", color: "#FFFFFF", border: "none", 
                  padding: "16px", borderRadius: "8px", fontSize: "16px", fontWeight: "700", 
                  cursor: "pointer", transition: "background-color 0.2s ease",
                  display: "block", width: "100%", minWidth: "100%",
                  whiteSpace: "nowrap", boxSizing: "border-box", flexShrink: 0
                }}
              >
                {status === "loading" ? "Searching..." : "Check Status"}
              </button>
            </div>

            {status === "error" && (
              <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0, marginTop: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, height: "auto", marginTop: 24 }} style={{ padding: "16px", backgroundColor: "#FEF2F2", border: "1px solid #FECACA", borderRadius: "8px", display: "flex", gap: "12px", alignItems: "flex-start", overflow: "hidden" }}>
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#DC2626" strokeWidth="2" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12"></line><line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16"></line></svg>
                <div>
                  <h4 style={{ fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#991B1B", margin: "0 0 4px 0" }}>Invalid Tracking Code</h4>
                  <p style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#B91C1C", margin: 0 }}>We could not find a report with this code. Please check the code and try again.</p>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        {status === "success" && caseData && (
          <div ref={containerRef} style={{ backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", borderRadius: "16px", padding: "32px", boxShadow: "0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0" }}>
            <div style={{ borderBottom: "1px solid #E2E8F0", paddingBottom: "24px", marginBottom: "32px" }}>
              <h2 style={{ fontSize: "24px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#001F3F", margin: "0 0 8px 0" }}>Report Status</h2>
              <p style={{ fontSize: "15px", color: "#64748B", margin: 0 }}>Tracking Code: <strong style={{ color: "#0F172A" }}>{caseData.code}</strong></p>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "0" }}>
              {stages.map((stage, index) => (
                <TimelineStage key={stage.id} stage={stage} index={index} totalStages={stages.length} caseData={caseData} timelineProgress={timelineProgress} prefersReduced={prefersReduced} />
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* FINAL OUTCOME DISPLAY: FINDINGS */}
            {caseData.outcome === "findings" && (
              <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} style={{ backgroundColor: "#F0FDF4", border: "1px solid #BBF7D0", borderRadius: "12px", padding: "24px", marginTop: "10px" }}>
                <h3 style={{ fontSize: "18px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#166534", marginBottom: "8px" }}>Investigation Concluded: Findings Published</h3>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "15px", color: "#14532D", lineHeight: "1.6", marginBottom: "16px" }}>
                  The VFMO has completed its assessment. The contractor was found to have engaged in unjustified cost inflation. A Sanction has been issued, and the matter has been referred to the Auditor-General for civil recovery.
                </p>
                <a href={generateFindingsPDF()} download={`VFMO_Findings_${caseData.code}.pdf`} style={{ display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", backgroundColor: "#166534", color: "#FFFFFF", textDecoration: "none", padding: "12px 24px", borderRadius: "8px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", cursor: "pointer" }}>
                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"></path><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"></line></svg>
                  Download Assessment Report (PDF)
                </a>
              </motion.div>
            )}

            {/* FINAL OUTCOME DISPLAY: DISMISSED */}
            {caseData.outcome === "dismissed" && (
              <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} style={{ backgroundColor: "#FEF2F2", border: "1px solid #FECACA", borderRadius: "12px", padding: "24px", marginTop: "10px" }}>
                <h3 style={{ fontSize: "18px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#991B1B", marginBottom: "8px" }}>Investigation Concluded: Dismissed</h3>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "15px", color: "#7F1D1D", lineHeight: "1.6", marginBottom: "16px" }}>
                  Pursuant to Section 46(2) of Act 1172, the VFMO has determined that this complaint is unsubstantiated, inadmissible, or does not fall within the mandate of the Office. No further action will be taken.
                </p>
                {/* Dismissal PDF Download */}
                <a href={generateDismissalPDF()} download={`VFMO_Dismissal_${caseData.code}.pdf`} style={{ display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", backgroundColor: "#991B1B", color: "#FFFFFF", textDecoration: "none", padding: "12px 24px", borderRadius: "8px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", cursor: "pointer" }}>
                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"></path><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"></line></svg>
                  Download Dismissal Notice (PDF)
                </a>
              </motion.div>
            )}

            {/* SIMULATION CONTROLS FOR THE PANEL */}
            <div style={{ marginTop: "30px", paddingTop: "20px", borderTop: "1px dashed #CBD5E1" }}>
              <p style={{ fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#64748B", textTransform: "uppercase", marginBottom: "12px", textAlign: "center" }}>Presentation Demo Controls</p>
              
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "12px", flexWrap: "wrap", justifyContent: "center" }}>
                
                {caseData.stage !== 2 && !caseData.outcome && (
                  <button onClick={simulateStage2} style={{ padding: "8px 12px", backgroundColor: "#F8FAFC", color: "#475569", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", borderRadius: "6px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "600", cursor: "pointer" }}>
                    Simulate: Stage 2 (Acknowledged)
                  </button>
                )}
                {caseData.stage !== 4 && !caseData.outcome && (
                  <button onClick={simulateStage4} style={{ padding: "8px 12px", backgroundColor: "#F8FAFC", color: "#475569", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", borderRadius: "6px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "600", cursor: "pointer" }}>
                    Simulate: Stage 4 (Investigating)
                  </button>
                )}

                {!caseData.outcome && (
                  <>
                    <button onClick={simulateFindings} style={{ padding: "8px 12px", backgroundColor: "#F0FDF4", color: "#166534", border: "1px solid #BBF7D0", borderRadius: "6px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "700", cursor: "pointer" }}>
                      Simulate: Case Closed (Findings)
                    </button>
                    <button onClick={simulateDismissed} style={{ padding: "8px 12px", backgroundColor: "#FEF2F2", color: "#991B1B", border: "1px solid #FECACA", borderRadius: "6px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "700", cursor: "pointer" }}>
                      Simulate: Deemed Not Worthy
                    </button>
                  </>
                )}

                {caseData.outcome && (
                  <button onClick={resetSimulation} style={{ padding: "8px 16px", backgroundColor: "#001F3F", color: "#FFFFFF", border: "none", borderRadius: "6px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "700", cursor: "pointer" }}>
                    Reset to Stage 3
                  </button>
                )}

              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  overflow-x: hidden; /* Prevents horizontal shake */
  overscroll-behavior-y: none; /* Stops Mac/Mobile rubber-band jitter */
}

*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: inherit;
  font-family: inherit; /* Ensures ALL elements inherit the Inter font */
}

/* =========================================
   GLOBAL SCROLL & JITTER FIXES
   ========================================= */

/* 1. Force GPU Rendering for all major sections to stop the jittery edges */
section, header, footer {
  transform: translateZ(0);
  -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
}

/* 2. Smooth out the scrollbar itself */
html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

/* 3. Stop fixed elements (like your gold scrollbar or navbar) from repainting the whole page */
#root > div > div:first-child {
  will-change: transform;
  transform: translateZ(0);
}

                    </a>

  );

import { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom"; 

export default function Submit() {
  const [fileName, setFileName] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitted, setIsSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [trackingCode, setTrackingCode] = useState("");
  const [agreedToTerms, setAgreedToTerms] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleFileChange = (e) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      setFileName(e.target.files[0].name);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!agreedToTerms) {
      alert("You must confirm that the information provided is true before submitting.");
      return;
    }
    const randomNum = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
    setTrackingCode(`VFM-WB-2026-${randomNum}`);
    setIsSubmitted(true);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#F4F5F0", minHeight: "100vh", overflowX: "hidden" }}>
      
      <style>
        {`
          .submit-btn-force {
            width: 100% !important;
            min-width: 100% !important;
            display: flex !important;
            justify-content: center !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            padding: 18px !important;
            white-space: nowrap !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            border: none !important;
            border-radius: 8px !important;
            font-size: 16px !important;
            font-weight: 800 !important;
            margin-top: 8px !important;
            transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease !important;
          }
        `}
      </style>

      <section style={{ 
        position: "relative", 
        padding: "80px 24px", 
        backgroundColor: "#001F3F", 
        textAlign: "center",
        overflow: "hidden"
      }}>
        <div style={{
          position: "absolute", top: "50%", left: "50%", transform: "translate(-50%, -50%)",
          width: "400px", height: "400px", backgroundImage: "url(/coat-of-arms.png)", 
          backgroundSize: "contain", backgroundRepeat: "no-repeat", backgroundPosition: "center",
          opacity: 0.05, zIndex: 0, pointerEvents: "none"
        }} />

        <div style={{ maxWidth: "800px", margin: "0 auto", position: "relative", zIndex: 1 }}>
          <h1 style={{ fontSize: "48px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#FFFFFF", margin: "0 0 16px 0", lineHeight: "1.1" }}>
            Report a Value for Money Concern
          </h1>
          <p style={{ fontSize: "18px", color: "#CBD5E1", maxWidth: "650px", margin: "0 auto", lineHeight: "1.6" }}>
            Submit a confidential report regarding public expenditure, contract inflation, or project irregularities.
          </p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#FCD116", padding: "16px 24px" }}>
        <div style={{ maxWidth: "800px", margin: "0 auto", display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-start", gap: "16px" }}>
          <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#001F3F" strokeWidth="2.5" style={{ flexShrink: 0, marginTop: "2px" }}><path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"></path></svg>
          <div>
            <h3 style={{ fontSize: "16px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#001F3F", margin: "0 0 4px 0" }}>Your identity is legally protected.</h3>
            <p style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#001F3F", margin: 0, lineHeight: "1.5", fontWeight: "500" }}>
              In accordance with the Whistleblower Act, 2006 (Act 720) and Section 48 of Act 1172, your identity will not be disclosed without your consent, unless required by a court order.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <section style={{ padding: "60px 24px", maxWidth: "800px", margin: "0 auto" }}>
        
        <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", borderRadius: "16px", padding: "24px", boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0", boxSizing: "border-box" }}>
          
          {isSubmitted ? (
            <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: "20px 0" }}>
              <div style={{ width: "80px", height: "80px", backgroundColor: "#10B98120", borderRadius: "50%", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", margin: "0 auto 24px auto" }}>
                <svg width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#10B981" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"></path><polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"></polyline></svg>
              </div>
              <h2 style={{ fontSize: "32px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A", marginBottom: "16px" }}>Report Received</h2>
              
              <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#F8FAFC", border: "1px dashed #CBD5E1", padding: "24px", borderRadius: "8px", marginBottom: "24px" }}>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#64748B", margin: "0 0 8px 0", fontWeight: "600" }}>YOUR TRACKING CODE</p>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "28px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#001F3F", margin: 0, letterSpacing: "2px" }}>{trackingCode}</p>
              </div>

              <p style={{ fontSize: "16px", color: "#475569", marginBottom: "24px", lineHeight: "1.6" }}>
                Please save this code. You will need it to track the status of your report.
              </p>
              
              <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#F0FDF4", padding: "16px", borderRadius: "8px", border: "1px solid #BBF7D0", textAlign: "left", marginBottom: "32px" }}>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#166534", margin: 0, lineHeight: "1.6" }}>
                  <strong>Statutory Timeline (Section 45):</strong><br/>
                  • The Office will acknowledge receipt of this complaint within <strong>7 days</strong>.<br/>
                  • A preliminary assessment will be conducted within <strong>14 days</strong> to determine if an investigation is warranted.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "16px", justifyContent: "center", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => { setIsSubmitted(false); setFileName(""); setAgreedToTerms(false); }}
                  style={{ padding: "14px 32px", backgroundColor: "#E2E8F0", color: "#001F3F", border: "none", borderRadius: "8px", fontSize: "16px", fontWeight: "700", cursor: "pointer" }}
                >
                  Submit Another Report
                </button>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/track?code=${trackingCode}`)}
                  style={{ padding: "14px 32px", backgroundColor: "#001F3F", color: "#FFFFFF", border: "none", borderRadius: "8px", fontSize: "16px", fontWeight: "700", cursor: "pointer" }}
                >
                  Track This Report Now
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "24px", width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box" }}>
              
              <div style={{ width: "100%" }}>
                <h3 style={{ fontSize: "18px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#001F3F", marginBottom: "16px", borderBottom: "1px solid #E2E8F0", paddingBottom: "8px" }}>Reporter Information (Optional)</h3>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#64748B", marginBottom: "16px" }}>You may submit this report anonymously. Leave these fields blank if you wish to remain unidentified.</p>
                <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr))", gap: "24px", width: "100%" }}>
                  <div>
                    <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#0F172A", marginBottom: "8px" }}>Full Name</label>
                    <input type="text" placeholder="Leave blank to remain anonymous" style={{ width: "100%", padding: "14px", borderRadius: "8px", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", fontSize: "16px", outline: "none", boxSizing: "border-box" }} />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#0F172A", marginBottom: "8px" }}>Email Address</label>
                    <input type="email" placeholder="For follow-up purposes" style={{ width: "100%", padding: "14px", borderRadius: "8px", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", fontSize: "16px", outline: "none", boxSizing: "border-box" }} />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ width: "100%" }}>
                <h3 style={{ fontSize: "18px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#001F3F", marginBottom: "16px", borderBottom: "1px solid #E2E8F0", paddingBottom: "8px", marginTop: "16px" }}>Incident Details</h3>
                
                <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "24px", width: "100%" }}>
                  <div>
                    <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#0F172A", marginBottom: "8px" }}>Covered Entity / Ministry</label>
                    <input type="text" required placeholder="e.g., Ministry of Roads and Highways" style={{ width: "100%", padding: "14px", borderRadius: "8px", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", fontSize: "16px", outline: "none", boxSizing: "border-box" }} />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#0F172A", marginBottom: "8px" }}>Project Name / Subject</label>
                    <input type="text" required placeholder="e.g., Tema Interchange Phase 2" style={{ width: "100%", padding: "14px", borderRadius: "8px", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", fontSize: "16px", outline: "none", boxSizing: "border-box" }} />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#0F172A", marginBottom: "8px" }}>Category of Complaint (Section 44)</label>
                    <select required style={{ width: "100%", padding: "14px", borderRadius: "8px", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", fontSize: "16px", outline: "none", backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", cursor: "pointer", boxSizing: "border-box" }}>
                      <option value="">Select a category...</option>
                      <option value="Contract Price Inflation">Contract Price Inflation</option>
                      <option value="Cost Irregularity / Waste">Cost Irregularity / Waste</option>
                      <option value="Breach of Quality Standards">Breach of Quality Standards</option>

                      <option value="Breach of VfM Standards">Breach of VfM Standards</option>
                    </select>

                    <textarea required rows="5" placeholder="Please provide as much detail as possible. State the nature of the irregularity, when it occurred, and any officials or contractors involved." style={{ width: "100%", padding: "14px", borderRadius: "8px", border: "1px solid #CBD5E1", fontSize: "16px", outline: "none", resize: "vertical", boxSizing: "border-box" }} />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ marginTop: "16px", width: "100%" }}>
                <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#0F172A", marginBottom: "8px" }}>Upload Supporting Evidence</label>
                <div style={{ border: "2px dashed #CBD5E1", borderRadius: "12px", padding: "32px", textAlign: "center", backgroundColor: "#F8FAFC", position: "relative", cursor: "pointer", width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box" }}>
                  <input type="file" onChange={handleFileChange} style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, width: "100%", height: "100%", opacity: 0, cursor: "pointer" }} />
                  
                  <div style={{ width: "48px", height: "48px", backgroundColor: "#E2E8F0", borderRadius: "50%", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", margin: "0 auto 16px auto" }}>
                    <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"></path><polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"></line></svg>
                  </div>
                  
                  <p style={{ fontSize: "16px", fontWeight: "600", color: "#0F172A", margin: "0 0 4px 0" }}>
                    {fileName ? fileName : "Click to upload or drag and drop"}
                  </p>
                  <p style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#64748B", margin: 0 }}>PDF, DOCX, XLSX, or Images (Max 25MB)</p>
                </div>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "12px", color: "#64748B", marginTop: "8px" }}>Ensure documents are redacted if they contain sensitive personal information.</p>
              </div>

              <div style={{ backgroundColor: "#FFF7ED", padding: "16px", borderRadius: "8px", border: "1px solid #FED7AA", marginTop: "16px", width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box" }}>
                <label style={{ display: "flex", gap: "12px", alignItems: "flex-start", cursor: "pointer" }}>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" 
                    checked={agreedToTerms} 
                    onChange={(e) => setAgreedToTerms(e.target.checked)} 
                    style={{ marginTop: "4px", width: "18px", height: "18px", cursor: "pointer" }} 
                  />
                  <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#9A3412", lineHeight: "1.5", fontWeight: "500" }}>
                    I declare that the information provided in this report is true to the best of my knowledge. I understand that intentionally providing false or misleading information to the Office is a criminal offence under <strong>Section 54 of the Value for Money Office Act, 2026 (Act 1172)</strong>.
                  </span>
                </label>
              </div>

              {/* FIXED BUTTON TEXT COLOR */}
              <button 
                type="submit" 
                disabled={!agreedToTerms}
                className="submit-btn-force"
                style={{ 
                  backgroundColor: agreedToTerms ? "#001F3F" : "#94A3B8", 
                  color: agreedToTerms ? "#FFFFFF" : "#475569", // <-- Dynamically changes text color
                  cursor: agreedToTerms ? "pointer" : "not-allowed"
                }}
              >
                Submit Report Securely
              </button>
            </form>
          )}
        </div>

        <div style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: "32px" }}>
          <Link to="/track" style={{ fontSize: "15px", color: "#001F3F", fontWeight: "700", textDecoration: "underline" }}>
            Already submitted a report? Track your complaint here.
          </Link>
        </div>

      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Link, useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Search, X, ChevronDown, ExternalLink, HelpCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence, useScroll, useTransform, useSpring, useMotionValue } from "framer-motion";
import { helpArticles } from "../data/helpData";

// Final (docked) size of the button. Must match the end value used in buttonWidth below.
const DOCKED_WIDTH = 48;
const DOCKED_HEIGHT = 52;

// Conversational filler words
const STOP_WORDS = new Set([
  "how", "do", "i", "can", "we", "the", "a", "an", "is", "are",
  "to", "for", "of", "in", "on", "what", "where", "when", "why",
  "who", "which", "my", "our", "it", "with", "about", "at", "by",
  "or", "and", "from", "be", "get", "need", "want"
]);

function getEditDistance(a, b) {
  if (a.length === 0) return b.length;
  if (b.length === 0) return a.length;

  const matrix = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= b.length; i++) matrix[i] = [i];
  for (let j = 0; j <= a.length; j++) matrix[0][j] = j;

  for (let i = 1; i <= b.length; i++) {
    for (let j = 1; j <= a.length; j++) {
      if (b.charAt(i - 1) === a.charAt(j - 1)) {
        matrix[i][j] = matrix[i - 1][j - 1];
      } else {
        matrix[i][j] = Math.min(
          matrix[i - 1][j - 1] + 1,
          matrix[i - 1][j] + 1,
          matrix[i][j - 1] + 1
        );
      }
    }
  }
  return matrix[b.length][a.length];
}

function isFuzzyMatch(word, target) {
  if (target.includes(word) || word.includes(target)) return true;
  if (word.length <= 3) return word === target;
  const maxDistance = word.length >= 6 ? 2 : 1;
  return getEditDistance(word, target) <= maxDistance;
}

function searchArticles(rawQuery, articles) {
  if (!rawQuery || !rawQuery.trim()) {
    return articles;
  }

  const cleanQuery = rawQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
  const rawTokens = cleanQuery.replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, " ").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const meaningfulTokens = rawTokens.filter((token) => !STOP_WORDS.has(token));
  const searchTokens = meaningfulTokens.length > 0 ? meaningfulTokens : rawTokens;

  const scoredArticles = articles.map((article) => {
    let score = 0;
    const titleLower = article.title.toLowerCase();
    const answerLower = article.answer.toLowerCase();
    const categoryLower = article.category.toLowerCase();
    const keywordsLower = article.keywords.map((k) => k.toLowerCase());

    if (titleLower.includes(cleanQuery)) score += 50;
    if (keywordsLower.some((k) => k.includes(cleanQuery))) score += 40;
    if (answerLower.includes(cleanQuery)) score += 15;

    searchTokens.forEach((token) => {
      if (titleLower.includes(token)) {
        score += 15;
      } else if (titleLower.split(/\s+/).some((w) => isFuzzyMatch(token, w))) {
        score += 8;
      }

      if (keywordsLower.some((k) => k === token)) {
        score += 20;
      } else if (keywordsLower.some((k) => k.includes(token))) {
        score += 12;
      } else if (keywordsLower.some((k) => isFuzzyMatch(token, k))) {
        score += 7;
      }

      if (categoryLower.includes(token)) {
        score += 8;
      }

      if (answerLower.includes(token)) {
        score += 4;
      }
    });

    return { article, score };
  });

  return scoredArticles
    .filter((item) => item.score > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
    .map((item) => item.article);
}

export default function FloatingHelpButton() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [openArticle, setOpenArticle] = useState(null);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);
  const [isReady, setIsReady] = useState(false);

  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const anchorX = useMotionValue(0);
  const anchorY = useMotionValue(0);
  const dockX = useMotionValue(0);
  const dockY = useMotionValue(0);
  const baseSize = useMotionValue(42);

  const { scrollY } = useScroll();
  const rawFlight = useTransform(scrollY, [0, 180], [0, 1]);

  const smoothFlight = useSpring(rawFlight, {
    stiffness: 120,
    damping: 26,
    mass: 0.5,
    restDelta: 0.001
  });

  const flight = useTransform(smoothFlight, (v) => Math.min(Math.max(v, 0), 1));

  const currentX = useTransform([flight, anchorX, dockX], ([p, ax, dx]) => ax + p * (dx - ax));
  const currentY = useTransform(
    [flight, anchorY, dockY],
    ([p, ay, dy]) => ay + p * (dy - ay) + Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 18
  );

  const buttonWidth = useTransform([flight, baseSize], ([p, bs]) => bs + p * (DOCKED_WIDTH - bs));
  const buttonHeight = useTransform([flight, baseSize], ([p, bs]) => bs + p * (DOCKED_HEIGHT - bs));

  const borderRadius = useTransform(flight, [0, 0.4, 1], [
    "4px 4px 4px 4px",
    "16px 16px 16px 16px",
    "24px 0px 0px 24px",
  ]);

  const backgroundColor = useTransform(flight, [0, 0.35, 1], ["#FFFFFF", "#FEEF85", "#FCD116"]);
  const borderStyle = useTransform(flight, (p) => (p < 0.15 ? "1px solid #CBD5E1" : "none"));
  const boxShadow = useTransform(
    flight,
    [0, 0.2, 1],
    ["0 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0)", "0 6px 16px rgba(0,31,63,0.12)", "0 8px 25px rgba(0,31,63,0.22)"]
  );

  const xOffset = useTransform(flight, [0, 0.85, 1], ["-50%", "-50%", "0%"]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateCoordinates = () => {
      const isMob = window.innerWidth <= 1200;
      setIsMobile(isMob);
      baseSize.set(isMob ? 38 : 42);

      const targetId = isMob ? "navbar-search-anchor-mobile" : "navbar-search-anchor";
      const navSlot = document.getElementById(targetId);

      if (navSlot) {
        const rect = navSlot.getBoundingClientRect();
        const currentScroll = window.scrollY;
        const trueTop = rect.top + currentScroll;

        anchorX.set(rect.left + rect.width / 2);
        anchorY.set(trueTop + rect.height / 2);
      }

      dockX.set(document.documentElement.clientWidth - DOCKED_WIDTH);
      dockY.set(window.innerHeight * 0.5);

      setIsReady(true);
    };

    updateCoordinates();

    window.addEventListener("resize", updateCoordinates);

    let resizeObserver;
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined") {
      resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(updateCoordinates);
      resizeObserver.observe(document.documentElement);
    }

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("resize", updateCoordinates);
      if (resizeObserver) resizeObserver.disconnect();
    };
  }, [anchorX, anchorY, dockX, dockY, baseSize]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsOpen(false);
    setSearchQuery("");
    setOpenArticle(null);
  }, [location.pathname]);

  const filteredArticles = searchArticles(searchQuery, helpArticles);

  const groupedArticles = filteredArticles.reduce((acc, article) => {
    if (!acc[article.category]) acc[article.category] = [];
    acc[article.category].push(article);
    return acc;
  }, {});

  const quickPills = [
    "Clearance",
    "Track Complaint",
    "Inflation Penalty",
    "Debarred List",
    "Portal Login",
  ];

  const isExcludedRoute =
    location.pathname === "/faq" ||
    location.pathname === "/portal" ||
    location.pathname.startsWith("/dashboard");

  if (isExcludedRoute || !isReady) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <>
      {/* SCROLL-INDUCED FLYING ICON */}
      {!isOpen && (
        <motion.div
          onClick={() => {
            if (flight.get() > 0.75) {
              setIsOpen(true);
            } else {
              navigate("/faq");
            }
          }}
          style={{
            position: "fixed",
            left: currentX,
            top: currentY,
            x: xOffset,
            y: "-50%",
            width: buttonWidth,
            height: buttonHeight,
            boxSizing: "border-box",
            borderRadius: borderRadius,
            backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
            border: borderStyle,
            boxShadow: boxShadow,
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            cursor: "pointer",
            zIndex: 9990,
            paddingRight: "4px",
            
            /* THE FIX: Force GPU rendering to stop the page shake */
            willChange: "transform",
            transform: "translateZ(0)",
            backfaceVisibility: "hidden",
          }}
          whileHover={{
            x: flight.get() > 0.75 ? "-10%" : "-50%",
            scale: flight.get() > 0.75 ? 1.05 : 1.02,
          }}
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
          title="Search Help Center"
        >
          <Search size={19} color="#001F3F" strokeWidth={2.4} />
        </motion.div>
      )}

      {/* ASSISTANT DRAWER */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isOpen && (
          <>
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
              onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
              style={{
                position: "fixed",
                inset: 0,
                backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.35)",
                backdropFilter: "blur(4px)",
                zIndex: 9998,
              }}
            />

            <motion.div
              initial={{ x: "100%", opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ x: 0, opacity: 1 }}
              exit={{ x: "100%", opacity: 0 }}
              transition={{ type: "spring", damping: 28, stiffness: 260 }}
              style={{
                position: "fixed",
                top: "16px",
                bottom: "16px",
                right: "16px",
                width: "calc(100vw - 32px)",
                maxWidth: "380px",
                backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
                borderRadius: "20px",
                boxShadow: "0 25px 60px -15px rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.35)",
                zIndex: 9999,
                display: "flex",
                flexDirection: "column",
                overflow: "hidden",
                border: "1px solid #E2E8F0",
              }}
            >
              {/* Header */}
              <div
                style={{
                  padding: "20px 24px",
                  borderBottom: "1px solid #F1F5F9",
                  display: "flex",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "space-between",
                  backgroundColor: "#001F3F",
                  color: "#FFFFFF",
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "10px" }}>
                  <div
                    style={{
                      width: "32px",
                      height: "32px",
                      borderRadius: "8px",
                      backgroundColor: "#FCD116",
                      display: "flex",
                      alignItems: "center",

                  <div>
                    <h4 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "16px", fontWeight: "800" }}>Help Center</h4>
                    <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "12px", opacity: 0.8 }}>Ask anything or search</p>
                  </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}

                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",

                  }}

              {/* Search Bar */}
              <div style={{ padding: "16px 20px 8px 20px", flexShrink: 0 }}>

                                  alignItems: "center",
                                  justifyContent: "space-between",
                                  cursor: "pointer",
                                  gap: "12px",
                                }}
                              >
                                <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: "600", color: "#0F172A", lineHeight: "1.3" }}>
                                  {article.title}
                                </span>
                                <ChevronDown
                                  size={16}
                                  color="#94A3B8"
                                  style={{
                                    flexShrink: 0,
                                    transform: isExpanded ? "rotate(180deg)" : "rotate(0deg)",
                                    transition: "transform 0.2s ease",
                                  }}
                                />
                              </div>

                              <div
                                style={{
                                  maxHeight: isExpanded ? "300px" : "0px",
                                  opacity: isExpanded ? 1 : 0,
                                  overflow: "hidden",
                                  transition: "max-height 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease",
                                }}
                              >
                                <div style={{ padding: "0 12px 12px 12px" }}>
                                  <p style={{ margin: "0 0 10px 0", fontSize: "12px", color: "#475569", lineHeight: "1.5" }}>
                                    {article.answer}
                                  </p>
                                  {article.link && (
                                    <Link
                                      to={article.link}
                                      onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                                      style={{
                                        display: "inline-flex",
                                        alignItems: "center",
                                        gap: "4px",
                                        fontSize: "12px",
                                        fontWeight: "700",
                                        color: "#001F3F",
                                        textDecoration: "none",
                                        borderBottom: "1px solid #001F3F",
                                      }}
                                    >
                                      {article.linkText}
                                      <ExternalLink size={10} />
                                    </Link>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <div style={{ padding: "30px 10px", textAlign: "center" }}>
                    <Search size={32} color="#94A3B8" style={{ marginBottom: "12px" }} />
                    <div style={{ fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#0F172A", marginBottom: "6px" }}>
                      No exact match for "{searchQuery}"
                    </div>
                    <p style={{ color: "#64748B", fontSize: "12px", margin: "0 0 16px 0" }}>
                      Try asking with simpler terms, or visit our primary services:
                    </p>
                    <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "6px" }}>
                      <Link
                        to="/clearance"
                        onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                        style={{ padding: "8px", backgroundColor: "#F8FAFC", borderRadius: "6px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "600", color: "#001F3F", textDecoration: "none" }}
                      >
                        Apply for Clearance →
                      </Link>
                      <Link
                        to="/track"
                        onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                        style={{ padding: "8px", backgroundColor: "#F8FAFC", borderRadius: "6px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "600", color: "#001F3F", textDecoration: "none" }}
                      >
                        Track a Complaint →
                      </Link>
                      <Link
                        to="/sanctions"
                        onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                        style={{ padding: "8px", backgroundColor: "#F8FAFC", borderRadius: "6px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "600", color: "#001F3F", textDecoration: "none" }}
                      >
                        Debarred Contractors Register →
                      </Link>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Footer CTA */}
              <div
                style={{
                  padding: "16px 20px",
                  borderTop: "1px solid #F1F5F9",
                  backgroundColor: "#FAFAFA",
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              >
                <Link
                  to={searchQuery ? `/faq?q=${encodeURIComponent(searchQuery)}` : "/faq"}
                  onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                  style={{
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    justifyContent: "center",
                    gap: "8px",
                    width: "100%",
                    padding: "12px",
                    borderRadius: "8px",
                    backgroundColor: "#001F3F",
                    color: "#FCD116",
                    textDecoration: "none",
                    fontWeight: "800",
                    fontSize: "14px",
                  }}
                >
                  <span>Explore Full FAQ Center</span>
                  <ExternalLink size={16} />
                </Link>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </>
  );
}

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { motion, useScroll, useTransform, useSpring, useMotionValue } from "framer-motion";
import SplitText from "./TextSplitter";

export default function InteractiveVfmWall() {
  const [hoveredWord, setHoveredWord] = useState(null);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);
  const [autoWord, setAutoWord] = useState(null);
  const [lastInteraction, setLastInteraction] = useState(Date.now());
  const [windowWidth, setWindowWidth] = useState(1200);

  // Drag repulsion state
  const [dragState, setDragState] = useState({
    activeWord: null,
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
  });

  const containerRef = useRef(null);
  const sectionRef = useRef(null);

  // Mouse physics motion values for 3D card tilt
  const mouseX = useMotionValue(0);
  const mouseY = useMotionValue(0);
  const springConfig = { damping: 25, stiffness: 120 };
  const smoothMouseX = useSpring(mouseX, springConfig);
  const smoothMouseY = useSpring(mouseY, springConfig);

  const rotateX = useTransform(smoothMouseY, [-0.5, 0.5], [6, -6]);
  const rotateY = useTransform(smoothMouseX, [-0.5, 0.5], [-6, 6]);

  // Scroll assembly
  const { scrollYProgress } = useScroll({
    target: sectionRef,
    offset: ["start end", "center center"],
  });
  const scrollAssemble = useSpring(scrollYProgress, { damping: 24, stiffness: 100 });

  // FIX: Hook is now at the top level so it doesn't crash on mobile
  const glareBackground = useTransform(
    [smoothMouseX, smoothMouseY],
    ([x, y]) =>
      `radial-gradient(480px circle at ${(x + 0.5) * 100}% ${(y + 0.5) * 100}%, rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.04), transparent 70%)`
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      setWindowWidth(window.innerWidth);
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth <= 768);
    };
    handleResize();
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
  }, []);

  // Idle mobile breathing
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMobile) return;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (Date.now() - lastInteraction < 2500) return;
      const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * words.length);
      setAutoWord(words[randomIndex].text);
      setTimeout(() => setAutoWord(null), 1200);
    }, 1800);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isMobile, lastInteraction]);

  const virtualWidth = 1200;
  const virtualHeight = 720;
  const dynamicMobileScale = Math.min((windowWidth - 32) / virtualWidth, 0.45);
  const currentScale = isMobile ? dynamicMobileScale : 1;

  // ALL 36 WORDS
  const rawWords = [
    { text: "ACCOUNTABILITY", top: "26%", left: "41.5%", size: "26px", weight: "900", depth: 25, color: "#2563EB", scatter: { x: -20, y: -70, z: 80, r: -4 } },
    { text: "LIFECYCLE COST", top: "30.5%", left: "41.5%", size: "20px", weight: "600", depth: 15, color: "#059669", scatter: { x: 10, y: -60, z: 50, r: 3 } },
    { text: "COST CONTROL", top: "34.5%", left: "45%", size: "22px", weight: "800", depth: 20, color: "#D97706", scatter: { x: 20, y: -40, z: 60, r: 4 } },
    { text: "COST EFFICIENCY", top: "39.5%", left: "43.5%", size: "34px", weight: "900", depth: 35, color: "#7C3AED", scatter: { x: 0, y: -30, z: 110, r: -2 } },
    { text: "RESOURCE USE", top: "31%", left: "21.5%", size: "16px", weight: "600", depth: 16, color: "#0284C7", scatter: { x: -70, y: -50, z: 70, r: -8 } },
    { text: "BEST VALUE", top: "34.5%", left: "21.5%", size: "18px", weight: "800", depth: 20, color: "#EA580C", scatter: { x: -60, y: -30, z: 60, r: 6 } },
    { text: "TRUST", top: "39%", left: "23%", size: "28px", weight: "900", depth: 30, color: "#E11D48", scatter: { x: -60, y: 0, z: 90, r: -8 } },
    { text: "BUDGET", top: "32%", left: "28.5%", size: "22px", weight: "900", rotate: "90deg", depth: 28, color: "#0D9488", scatter: { x: -40, y: -40, z: 80, r: 20 } },
