    if (isMobile || !containerRef.current || dragState.activeWord) return;
    const rect = containerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouseX.set((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width - 0.5);
    mouseY.set((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height - 0.5);
  };

  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
    mouseX.set(0);
    mouseY.set(0);
    setHoveredWord(null);
  };

  const handleWordDrag = (word, info) => {
    if (!info || !info.offset) return;
    setLastInteraction(Date.now());
    setDragState({
      activeWord: word.text,
      x: word.canvasX + info.offset.x / currentScale,
      y: word.canvasY + info.offset.y / currentScale,
    });
  };

  const handleWordDragEnd = () => {
    setDragState({ activeWord: null, x: 0, y: 0 });
  };

  return (
    <section
      ref={sectionRef}
      style={{
        backgroundColor: "#F8F9FA",
        padding: isMobile ? "20px 0" : "80px 24px",
        overflow: "hidden",
        display: "flex",
        justifyContent: "center",
        alignItems: "center",
        perspective: "1200px",
      }}
    >
      <motion.div
        ref={containerRef}
        onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
        onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
        style={{
          position: "relative",
          width: isMobile ? `${virtualWidth * dynamicMobileScale}px` : "1200px",
          height: isMobile ? `${virtualHeight * dynamicMobileScale}px` : `${virtualHeight}px`,
          backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
          borderRadius: isMobile ? "12px" : "28px",
          boxShadow: isMobile
            ? "none"
            : "inset 0 40px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.03), 0 35px 70px -15px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)",
          overflow: "hidden",
          transformStyle: "preserve-3d",
        }}
        animate={{
          rotateX: isMobile || dragState.activeWord ? 0 : rotateX.get(),
          rotateY: isMobile || dragState.activeWord ? 0 : rotateY.get(),
        }}
        transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 100, damping: 25 }}
      >
        {!isMobile && (
          <motion.div
            style={{
              position: "absolute",
              inset: 0,
              background: glareBackground,
              pointerEvents: "none",
              zIndex: 0,
            }}
          />
        )}

        <div
          style={{
            position: "absolute",
            width: `${virtualWidth}px`,
            height: `${virtualHeight}px`,
            transform: isMobile ? `scale(${dynamicMobileScale})` : "none",
            transformOrigin: "top left",
            transformStyle: "preserve-3d",
          }}
        >
          {words.map((word, index) => {
            const isHovered = hoveredWord === word.text;
            const isAuto = autoWord === word.text;
            const isBeingDragged = dragState.activeWord === word.text;
            const isActive = isHovered || isAuto || isBeingDragged;
            const isDimmed =
              (hoveredWord !== null || autoWord !== null || dragState.activeWord !== null) &&
              !isActive;

            let repelX = 0;
            let repelY = 0;
            if (dragState.activeWord && !isBeingDragged) {
              const dx = word.canvasX - dragState.x;
              const dy = word.canvasY - dragState.y;
              const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
              const partRadius = 135;

              if (dist < partRadius && dist > 0) {
                const force = (1 - dist / partRadius) * 55;
                repelX = (dx / dist) * force;
                repelY = (dy / dist) * force;
              }
            }

            return (
              <WordItem
                key={index}
                word={word}
                isActive={isActive}
                isDimmed={isDimmed}
                isBeingDragged={isBeingDragged}
                repelX={repelX}
                repelY={repelY}
                isMobile={isMobile}
                scrollAssemble={scrollAssemble}
                smoothMouseX={smoothMouseX}
                smoothMouseY={smoothMouseY}
                onSelect={() => {
                  setHoveredWord(word.text);
                  setLastInteraction(Date.now());
                }}
                onDeselect={() => setHoveredWord(null)}
                onDrag={(info) => handleWordDrag(word, info)}
                onDragEnd={handleWordDragEnd}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </section>
  );
}

function WordItem({
  word,
  isActive,
  isDimmed,
  isBeingDragged,
  repelX,
  repelY,
  isMobile,
  scrollAssemble,
  smoothMouseX,
  smoothMouseY,
  onSelect,
  onDeselect,
  onDrag,
  onDragEnd,
}) {
  const scatterX = useTransform(scrollAssemble, [0, 1], [word.scatter.x, 0]);
  const scatterY = useTransform(scrollAssemble, [0, 1], [word.scatter.y, 0]);
  const scatterZ = useTransform(scrollAssemble, [0, 1], [word.scatter.z, word.depth]);
  const scatterRotate = useTransform(scrollAssemble, [0, 1], [word.scatter.r, 0]);
  const scrollOpacity = useTransform(scrollAssemble, [0, 0.4, 1], [0, 0.6, 1]);

  const parallaxX = useTransform(smoothMouseX, [-0.5, 0.5], [-word.depth * 0.4, word.depth * 0.4]);
  const parallaxY = useTransform(smoothMouseY, [-0.5, 0.5], [-word.depth * 0.4, word.depth * 0.4]);

  const baseX = useTransform([scatterX, parallaxX], ([s, p]) => (isMobile ? 0 : s + p));
  const baseY = useTransform([scatterY, parallaxY], ([s, p]) => (isMobile ? 0 : s + p));
  const wordRotate = useTransform(scatterRotate, (r) =>
    isMobile ? word.rotate || "0deg" : `${r + (parseInt(word.rotate) || 0)}deg`
  );

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "absolute",
        top: word.top,
        left: word.left,
        transform: "translate(-50%, -50%)",
        transformStyle: "preserve-3d",
        zIndex: isBeingDragged ? 100 : isActive ? 50 : Math.floor(word.depth),
      }}
    >
      <motion.div
        style={{
          x: baseX,
          y: baseY,
          z: isMobile ? 0 : scatterZ,
          rotate: wordRotate,
        }}
        animate={{
          x: repelX,
          y: repelY,
        }}
        transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 300, damping: 25 }}
      >
        <motion.div
          data-word={word.text}
          drag
          dragSnapToOrigin={true}
          dragElastic={0.4}
          onDrag={(e, info) => onDrag(info)}
          onDragEnd={onDragEnd}
          onMouseEnter={onSelect}
          onMouseLeave={onDeselect}
          onTouchStart={onSelect}
          whileDrag={{
            scale: 1.18,
            zIndex: 100,
            cursor: "grabbing",
          }}
          style={{
            fontSize: word.size,
            fontWeight: word.weight,
            userSelect: "none",
            cursor: isBeingDragged ? "grabbing" : "grab",
            whiteSpace: "nowrap",
            letterSpacing: "-0.035em",
            wordSpacing: "-0.06em",
            lineHeight: 1,
            transformOrigin: "center center",
            filter: isDimmed ? "blur(1px)" : "blur(0px)",
          }}
          animate={{
            scale: isActive ? 1.15 : 1,
            opacity: isDimmed ? 0.2 : 1,
          }}
          transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 350, damping: 25 }}
        >
          <motion.div style={{ opacity: isMobile ? 1 : scrollOpacity }}>
            {SplitText ? (
              <SplitText
                text={word.text}
                hoveredWord={isActive ? word.text : null}
                baseColor="#2d3748"
                hoverColor={word.color}
                isMobile={isMobile}
              />
            ) : (
              <span
                style={{
                  color: isActive ? word.color : "#2d3748",
                  transition: "color 0.2s ease",
                }}
              >
                {word.text}
              </span>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

export default function Hero() {
  const slides = [
    {
      headline1: "Every Cedi Counts.",
      headline2: "Every Outcome Matters.",
      subheadline: "The Value for Money Office is an independent statutory authority established under Act 1172 to regulate, monitor, and conduct value for money assessments across Ghana's public sector.",
      btnText: "Learn About Our Mandate",
      btnLink: "/about",
      bgImage: "/hero-bg.jpg", 
    },
    {
      headline1: "Statutory Independence.",
      headline2: "Unwavering Fiscal Integrity.",
      subheadline: "Except as otherwise provided by law, the Office is not subject to the direction or control of any person or authority in the performance of its statutory functions. (Section 12)",
      btnText: "Read Our Institutional Values",
      btnLink: "/about#values",
      bgImage: "/hero-slide-2.jpg", 
    },
    {
      headline1: "Protecting the Public Purse.",
      headline2: "Guaranteeing Citizen Value.",
      subheadline: "We provide a confidential, legally protected mechanism for citizens and entities to report contract inflation, cost irregularities, and the abuse of public resources.",
      btnText: "Report a Concern",
      btnLink: "/submit",
      bgImage: "/hero-slide-3.jpg", 
    }
  ];

  const [currentSlide, setCurrentSlide] = useState(0);

  const touchStart = useRef(null);
  const touchEnd = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setCurrentSlide((prev) => (prev === slides.length - 1 ? 0 : prev + 1));
    }, 8000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [slides.length]);

  const handleTouchStart = (e) => {
    touchStart.current = e.targetTouches[0].clientX;
  };

  const handleTouchMove = (e) => {
    touchEnd.current = e.targetTouches[0].clientX;
  };

  const handleTouchEnd = () => {
    if (!touchStart.current || !touchEnd.current) return;
    const distance = touchStart.current - touchEnd.current;
    const isLeftSwipe = distance > 50;
    const isRightSwipe = distance < -50;

    if (isLeftSwipe) {
      setCurrentSlide((prev) => (prev === slides.length - 1 ? 0 : prev + 1));
    }
    if (isRightSwipe) {
      setCurrentSlide((prev) => (prev === 0 ? slides.length - 1 : prev - 1));
    }

    touchStart.current = null;
    touchEnd.current = null;
  };

  return (
    <section style={{ 
      position: "relative", 
      backgroundColor: "#001F3F", 
      overflow: "hidden", 
      display: "flex", 
      flexDirection: "column", 
      height: "80vh",
      minHeight: "600px" 
    }}>
      
      <style>
        {`
          .hero-track {
            display: flex;
            height: 100%;
            transition: transform 1s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
          }

          .hero-btn {
            background-color: #FCD116; 
            color: #001F3F; 
            border: none; 
            padding: 16px 40px; 
            border-radius: 4px; 
            font-size: 16px; 
            font-weight: 800; 
            cursor: pointer; 
            transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-decoration: none;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(252, 209, 22, 0.4);
          }

          .hero-btn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
            background-color: #FFDE45;
          }

          @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .hero-btn {
              width: 100%;
              padding: 16px 24px;
            }
          }
        `}
      </style>

      <div 
        style={{ position: "relative", flex: 1, overflow: "hidden", width: "100%" }}
        onTouchStart={handleTouchStart} 
        onTouchMove={handleTouchMove} 
        onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
      >
        <div 
          className="hero-track"
          style={{ transform: `translateX(-${currentSlide * 100}%)` }}
        >
          {slides.map((slide, index) => (
            <div 
              key={index} 
              style={{ 
                minWidth: "100%", 
                width: "100%", 
                position: "relative", 
                display: "flex", 
                alignItems: "center", 
                justifyContent: "center" 
              }}
            >
              
              <div style={{

                backgroundSize: "cover", 
                backgroundPosition: "center", 
                opacity: 0.85, 
                zIndex: 0 
              }} />
              
              <div style={{ 
                position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, 
                background: "rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.75)", 
                zIndex: 1 
              }} />

              {/* TEXT CONTENT */}
              <div style={{ 
                maxWidth: "900px",

                // FIX 1: Increased bottom padding to push the button up away from the dots
                padding: "40px 24px 80px 24px", 
                position: "relative", 
                zIndex: 2,
                textAlign: "center", 
                display: "flex",
                flexDirection: "column",
                alignItems: "center"
              }}>
                
                <div style={{ marginBottom: "16px" }}>
                  <span style={{ 
                    fontSize: "14px", 
                    fontWeight: "800", 
                    color: "#FCD116", 
                    textTransform: "uppercase", 
                    letterSpacing: "1.5px", 
                    textShadow: "0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)" 
                  }}>
                    Value For Money Office
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h1 style={{ 
                  fontSize: "clamp(42px, 6vw, 64px)",

                  margin: "0 0 24px 0",

}

// --- SCROLL ANIMATION HOOK ---
function useScrollReveal(isMobile) {
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isMobile) {
      setIsVisible(true);
      return;
    }

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => { setIsVisible(entry.isIntersecting); },
      { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: "0px 0px -50px 0px" }
    );
    if (ref.current) observer.observe(ref.current);
    return () => { if (ref.current) observer.unobserve(ref.current); };
  }, [isMobile]);

  return [ref, isVisible];
}

const Reveal = ({ children, delay = 0, width = "100%", isMobile }) => {
  const [ref, isVisible] = useScrollReveal(isMobile);
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      style={{
        opacity: isVisible ? 1 : 0,
        transform: isVisible ? "translateY(0)" : "translateY(40px)",
        transition: `opacity 0.6s ease-out ${delay}s, transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) ${delay}s`,
        width: width
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
};

export default function AboutUs() {
  const { hash } = useLocation();
  const [openScope, setOpenScope] = useState(0);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkMobile = () => setIsMobile(window.matchMedia("(max-width: 992px)").matches);
    checkMobile();
    window.addEventListener("resize", checkMobile);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", checkMobile);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hash) {
      const element = document.getElementById(hash.replace("#", ""));
      if (element) {
        element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
      }
    } else {
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    }
  }, [hash]);

  const stats = [
    { number: "Act 1172", unit: "", label: "LEGAL FRAMEWORK", sub: "Value for Money Office Act, 2026", icon: HandDrawnScaleIcon, isGold: false },
    { number: "16", unit: "Regions", label: "NATIONAL COVERAGE", sub: "Across all administrative regions", icon: HandDrawnPinIcon, isGold: true },
    { number: "14", unit: "Days", label: "COMPLAINT ASSESSMENT", sub: "Statutory Timeline (Section 45)", icon: HandDrawnClockIcon, isGold: false },
    { number: "2 – 5", unit: "Years", label: "DEBARMENT PENALTY", sub: "For Cost Inflation (Section 38)", icon: HandDrawnBanIcon, isGold: true },
  ];

  const scopes = [
    { title: "Statutory Pre-Contract Reviews", desc: "Mandatory evaluation of all major capital projects and single-source procurements prior to the award of contract." },
    { title: "Compliance & Sanctions", desc: "Continuous oversight of project execution, with the statutory power to halt non-compliant processes and apply administrative penalties." },
    { title: "Institutional Standards", desc: "Setting national benchmarks for cost estimation, lifecycle maintenance, and value-for-money auditing across all MDAs." },
    { title: "Public Reporting", desc: "Publishing annual value-for-money registers and gazetted findings to ensure transparency and citizen accountability." }

================
File: src/pages/WhatWeDo.jsx

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useLocation, Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { motion, useScroll, useTransform } from "framer-motion";

// --- SERIOUS.BUSINESS STYLE STACKING CARD WRAPPER ---
const StackCard = ({ children, index, id, total }) => {
  const cardRef = useRef(null);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkMobile = () => setIsMobile(window.matchMedia("(max-width: 900px)").matches);
    checkMobile();
    window.addEventListener("resize", checkMobile);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", checkMobile);
  }, []);

  const { scrollYProgress } = useScroll({
    target: cardRef,
    offset: ["start start", "end start"],
  });

  const scale = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], [1, isMobile ? 1 : 0.95]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={cardRef}
      id={id}
      style={{
        position: isMobile ? "relative" : "sticky",
        top: isMobile ? "auto" : `calc(80px + ${index * 16}px)`,
        zIndex: index + 1,
        width: "100%",
        marginBottom: isMobile ? "32px" : `${(total - index) * 10}px`,
      }}
    >
      <motion.div
        style={{
          scale,
          transformOrigin: "top center",
          borderRadius: "28px",
          boxShadow: isMobile ? "0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" : "0 -18px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16)",
          overflow: "hidden",
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default function WhatWeDo() {
  const { hash } = useLocation();
  const [activePillar, setActivePillar] = useState(0);

  const touchStart = useRef(null);
  const touchEnd = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hash) {
      const element = document.getElementById(hash.replace("#", ""));
      if (element) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
        }, 150);
      }
    } else {
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    }
  }, [hash]);

  const pillars = [
    {
      id: "assessments",
      category: "Assessments",
      title: "Pre-Contract & Technical VfM Assessments",
      description: "Conducting mandatory ex-ante reviews of major capital projects to ensure proposed costs are reasonable and represent maximum value before public funds are committed.",

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setActivePillar((prev) => (prev === pillars.length - 1 ? 0 : prev + 1));
    }, 6000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [pillars.length]);

  const handleTouchStart = (e) => {
    touchStart.current = e.targetTouches[0].clientX;
  };

  const handleTouchMove = (e) => {
    touchEnd.current = e.targetTouches[0].clientX;
  };

  const handleTouchEnd = () => {
    if (!touchStart.current || !touchEnd.current) return;
    const distance = touchStart.current - touchEnd.current;
    const isLeftSwipe = distance > 50;
    const isRightSwipe = distance < -50;

    if (isLeftSwipe) {
      setActivePillar((prev) => (prev === pillars.length - 1 ? 0 : prev + 1));
    }
    if (isRightSwipe) {
      setActivePillar((prev) => (prev === 0 ? pillars.length - 1 : prev - 1));
    }

    touchStart.current = null;
    touchEnd.current = null;

                    onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                      e.currentTarget.style.transform = "translateY(0)";

                  >
                    Engage Our Technical Team

// --- NATIVE MOBILE RISE ---
const MobileRise = ({ children }) => {
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => { setIsVisible(entry.isIntersecting); },
      { threshold: 0.05, rootMargin: "0px 0px -80px 0px" }
    );
    if (ref.current) observer.observe(ref.current);
    return () => { if (ref.current) observer.unobserve(ref.current); };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      style={{
        opacity: isVisible ? 1 : 0,
        transform: isVisible ? "translateY(0)" : "translateY(40px)",
        transition: "opacity 0.8s ease-out, transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
        width: "100%"
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
};

// --- DUAL-MODE STACK SECTION WRAPPER ---
const StackSection = ({ children, index }) => {
  const containerRef = useRef(null);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkMobile = () => setIsMobile(window.matchMedia("(max-width: 768px)").matches);
    checkMobile();
    window.addEventListener("resize", checkMobile);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", checkMobile);
  }, []);
  
  const { scrollYProgress } = useScroll({
    target: containerRef,
    offset: ["start start", "end start"] 
  });

  const scale = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], [1, isMobile ? 1 : 0.92]);
  const opacity = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 0.8, 1], [1, 1, isMobile ? 1 : 0.6]);
  const borderRadius = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], ["0px", isMobile ? "0px" : "32px"]);

  return (
    <div 
      ref={containerRef} 
      style={{ 
        position: isMobile ? "relative" : "sticky",
        top: isMobile ? "auto" : 0,
        zIndex: index + 1,
        width: "100%",
        marginTop: index === 0 ? 0 : (isMobile ? "0" : "-20px")
      }}
    >
      <motion.div
        style={{
          scale,
          opacity,
          borderRadius,
          overflow: "hidden",
          transformOrigin: "top center",
          boxShadow: isMobile ? "none" : "0 -10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)",
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
};

// src/pages/Publications.jsx
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { motion, useScroll, useTransform, useReducedMotion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import { getPublications, LS_PUBLICATIONS_EVENT } from "../cms/services/mockData";

// ========================================================
// 1. HAND-DRAWN ICONS
// ========================================================
const HandDrawnDocument = () => (
  <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="#001F3F" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    <path d="M12 6 C12 4.5, 13.5 4, 15 4 L33 4 L40 11 L40 42 C40 43.5, 38.5 44, 37 44 L15 44 C13.5 44, 12 43.5, 12 42 Z" />
    <path d="M30 4 L30 14 L40 14" />
    <path d="M18 20 L28 20" strokeWidth="2" />
    <path d="M18 28 L34 28" strokeWidth="2" />
    <path d="M18 36 L24 36" strokeWidth="2" />
  </svg>
);

const HandDrawnDownloadIcon = () => (
  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>
    <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"></path>
    <polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"></polyline>
    <line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"></line>
  </svg>
);

const HandDrawnClose = () => (
  <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line>
    <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
  </svg>
);

// ========================================================
// 2. REVEAL HELPERS
// ========================================================
const Reveal = ({ children, delay = 0, y = 40, once = true }) => {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);
  const prefersReduced = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          if (once) observer.unobserve(el);
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: "0px 0px -60px 0px" }
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [once]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      style={{
        opacity: prefersReduced ? 1 : inView ? 1 : 0,
        transform: prefersReduced ? "none" : inView ? "translateY(0)" : `translateY(${y}px)`,
        transition: `opacity 0.8s ease-out ${delay}s, transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) ${delay}s`,
        willChange: "opacity, transform",
        width: "100%",
        height: "100%",
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
};

const RevealText = ({ text, as: Tag = "span", style = {}, delay = 0, wordDelay = 0.05 }) => {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);
  const prefersReduced = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          observer.unobserve(el);
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.2 }
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const words = String(text).split(" ");

  return (
    <Tag ref={ref} style={{ ...style, display: "inline" }}>
      {words.map((word, i) => (
        <span key={i} style={{ display: "inline-block", overflow: "hidden", verticalAlign: "top" }}>
          <motion.span
            initial={prefersReduced ? { y: 0, opacity: 1 } : { y: "110%", opacity: 0 }}
            animate={inView ? { y: 0, opacity: 1 } : prefersReduced ? { y: 0, opacity: 1 } : { y: "110%", opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], delay: delay + i * wordDelay }}
            style={{ display: "inline-block", willChange: "transform" }}
          >
            {word}
          </motion.span>
          {i < words.length - 1 && <span>&nbsp;</span>}
        </span>
      ))}
    </Tag>
  );
};

// ========================================================
// 3. MAIN PAGE
// ========================================================
export default function Publications() {
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState("Annual Reviews");
  const [isHovered, setIsHovered] = useState(false);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);

  const [activeNoticeIndex, setActiveNoticeIndex] = useState(null);
  const [activeDocIndex, setActiveDocIndex] = useState(null);

  const prefersReduced = useReducedMotion();

  const mobileNewsRef = useRef(null);
  const mobileDocsRef = useRef(null);

  const [isNewsInteracting, setIsNewsInteracting] = useState(false);
  const [isDocsInteracting, setIsDocsInteracting] = useState(false);

  const newsTimerRef = useRef(null);
  const docsTimerRef = useRef(null);

  // ---- REACTIVE CMS SYNC ----
  // getPublications() returns the original site content unless the CMS has saved changes.
  const [notices, setNotices] = useState(() => getPublications());

  useEffect(() => {
    const refresh = () => setNotices(getPublications());
    window.addEventListener(LS_PUBLICATIONS_EVENT, refresh); // same-tab (CMS publish / delete / reset)
    window.addEventListener("storage", refresh);             // cross-tab
    window.addEventListener("focus", refresh);               // tab refocus
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(LS_PUBLICATIONS_EVENT, refresh);
      window.removeEventListener("storage", refresh);
      window.removeEventListener("focus", refresh);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkMobile = () => setIsMobile(window.matchMedia("(max-width: 992px)").matches);
    checkMobile();
    window.addEventListener("resize", checkMobile);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", checkMobile);
  }, []);

  const heroRef = useRef(null);
  const { scrollYProgress } = useScroll({ target: heroRef, offset: ["start start", "end start"] });
  const heroBgY = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], ["0%", "25%"]);
  const heroContentY = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], [0, 80]);
  const heroOpacity = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 0.9], [1, 0]);
  const heroScale = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], [1, 1.08]);

  const filters = [
    "Annual Reviews",
    "Methodology Frameworks",
    "VFMO Evaluation Guidelines",
    "Advisory Briefs",
  ];

  // Triplicated so the vertical carousel can loop seamlessly
  const playlistNotices = [...notices, ...notices, ...notices];

  const documents = [
    { date: "Jan 2027", category: "Annual Reviews", title: "2026 Annual Report to Parliament", desc: "The Office's inaugural annual report on the activities, operations, and financial performance of the VFMO Office, including a summary of public savings realised. (Section 26)", fileSize: "3.2 MB" },
    { date: "Dec 2026", category: "Annual Reviews", title: "Q4 2026 VFMO Assessment Findings", desc: "A quarterly publication summarising systemic inefficiencies identified during value for money assessments and policy recommendations arising from them. (Section 39)", fileSize: "1.9 MB" },
    { date: "Nov 2026", category: "Methodology Frameworks", title: "National Cost Benchmarks for Civil Works (2026)", desc: "Standardised cost benchmarks for commonly procured goods, works, and services to be used by covered entities in planning and budgeting. (Section 36)", fileSize: "4.5 MB" },
    { date: "Oct 2026", category: "VFMO Evaluation Guidelines", title: "Standard Operating Procedures for Pre-Award Assessments", desc: "Technical guidelines detailing the methodology for independent evaluation of cost estimates, technical specifications, and value justification prior to contract execution. (Section 34)", fileSize: "2.1 MB" },
    { date: "Sep 2026", category: "Advisory Briefs", title: "Guidelines for Public Stakeholder Engagement", desc: "Procedural guidelines for facilitating public participation, citizen feedback, and stakeholder consultations in high-value public sector projects. (Section 43)", fileSize: "1.4 MB" },
    { date: "Aug 2026", category: "Methodology Frameworks", title: "Administrative Penalties Schedule", desc: "The official schedule specifying indicative penalty bands for different categories of contraventions and non-compliance under the Act. (Section 59)", fileSize: "1.1 MB" },
  ];

  const desktopFilteredDocuments = documents.filter((doc) => doc.category === activeFilter);
  const mobileDisplayedDocuments = documents;

  // Auto-rotate the featured notice on desktop
  useEffect(() => {
    if (notices.length === 0) return;
    if (isHovered || prefersReduced || isMobile) return;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setActiveNoticeIndex((prev) => (prev === null ? 0 : (prev + 1) % notices.length));
    }, 6000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isHovered, prefersReduced, isMobile, notices.length]);

  // Mobile news auto-scroll
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMobile || isNewsInteracting || prefersReduced) return;
    const startAutoScroll = () => {
      if (newsTimerRef.current) clearInterval(newsTimerRef.current);
      newsTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        if (mobileNewsRef.current && !isNewsInteracting) {
          const container = mobileNewsRef.current;
          const maxScroll = container.scrollWidth - container.clientWidth;
          if (container.scrollLeft >= maxScroll - 10) {
            container.scrollTo({ left: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
          } else {
            container.scrollBy({ left: 280, behavior: "smooth" });
          }
        }
      }, 3500);
    };
    startAutoScroll();
    return () => { if (newsTimerRef.current) clearInterval(newsTimerRef.current); };
  }, [isMobile, isNewsInteracting, prefersReduced]);

  const handleNewsTouchStart = () => {
    setIsNewsInteracting(true);
    if (newsTimerRef.current) clearInterval(newsTimerRef.current);
  };
  const handleNewsTouchEnd = () => {
    setTimeout(() => setIsNewsInteracting(false), 4000);
  };

  // Mobile docs auto-scroll
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMobile || isDocsInteracting || prefersReduced) return;
    const startAutoScroll = () => {
      if (docsTimerRef.current) clearInterval(docsTimerRef.current);
      docsTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        if (mobileDocsRef.current && !isDocsInteracting) {
          const container = mobileDocsRef.current;
          const maxScroll = container.scrollWidth - container.clientWidth;
          if (container.scrollLeft >= maxScroll - 10) {
            container.scrollTo({ left: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
          } else {
            container.scrollBy({ left: 300, behavior: "smooth" });
          }
        }
      }, 4500);
    };
    startAutoScroll();
    return () => { if (docsTimerRef.current) clearInterval(docsTimerRef.current); };
  }, [isMobile, isDocsInteracting, prefersReduced]);

  const handleDocsTouchStart = () => {
    setIsDocsInteracting(true);
    if (docsTimerRef.current) clearInterval(docsTimerRef.current);
  };
  const handleDocsTouchEnd = () => {
    setTimeout(() => setIsDocsInteracting(false), 4000);
  };

  // Featured card: use the selected notice, otherwise the newest (index 0),
  // which is the most recent CMS publish. Guarded so deleting items or a reset
  // can never leave us pointing at an index that no longer exists.
  const featuredNotice = notices[activeNoticeIndex ?? 0] ?? notices[0];
  const activeNotice = activeNoticeIndex !== null ? notices[activeNoticeIndex] ?? null : null;

  return (
    <div style={{ position: "relative", backgroundColor: "#F4F5F0", minHeight: "100vh", overflowX: "hidden", fontFamily: "'Inter', sans-serif" }}>
      <style>
        {`
          .hide-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
          .hide-scrollbar { -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none; }

          @keyframes scrollPlaylist {
            0% { transform: translateY(0); }
            100% { transform: translateY(-33.3333%); }
          }
          .playlist-container {
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            height: 520px;
            mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, black 5%, black 95%, transparent);
            -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, black 5%, black 95%, transparent);
          }
          .playlist-track {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 16px;
            animation: scrollPlaylist 28s linear infinite;
          }
          .playlist-container:hover .playlist-track { animation-play-state: paused; }

          .mobile-scroll-container {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
            scrollbar-width: none;
            -ms-overflow-style: none;
            -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
            padding-bottom: 10px;
          }
          .mobile-scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
          
          .mobile-scroll-container::after {
            content: '';
            flex: 0 0 24px;
          }

          .mobile-news-card {
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            flex: 0 0 85%;
            max-width: 300px;
          }

          .mobile-doc-card {
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            flex: 0 0 85%;
            max-width: 320px;
            background-color: #FFFFFF;
            border-radius: 16px;
            border: 1px solid #E2E8F0;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
          }
        `}
      </style>

      <div aria-hidden="true" style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 0, pointerEvents: "none", backgroundImage: "url(/vfm-logo.png)", backgroundRepeat: "no-repeat", backgroundPosition: "center center", backgroundSize: "min(85vw, 900px)", opacity: 0.03, filter: "grayscale(10%)" }} />

      <div style={{ position: "relative", zIndex: 1 }}>
        <section ref={heroRef} style={{ backgroundColor: "rgba(0,31,63,0.98)", padding: "100px 24px 120px", position: "relative", overflow: "hidden" }}>
          <motion.div style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: "-15%", backgroundImage: "url(/coat-of-arms.png)", backgroundSize: "contain", backgroundRepeat: "no-repeat", backgroundPosition: "right -100px center", opacity: 0.05, zIndex: 0, y: prefersReduced ? 0 : heroBgY, scale: prefersReduced ? 1 : heroScale }} />

          <div style={{ maxWidth: "1200px", margin: "0 auto", position: "relative", zIndex: 1 }}>
            <motion.div style={{ marginBottom: "50px", textAlign: "center", y: prefersReduced ? 0 : heroContentY, opacity: prefersReduced ? 1 : heroOpacity }}>
              <h1 style={{ fontSize: "clamp(36px, 5vw, 52px)", fontWeight: "800", color: "#FFFFFF", margin: "0 0 16px 0", lineHeight: "1.1" }}>
                <RevealText text="News & Publications" delay={0.1} />
              </h1>
              <p style={{ fontSize: "clamp(16px, 2vw, 18px)", color: "#CBD5E1", maxWidth: "700px", lineHeight: "1.6", margin: "0 auto" }}>
                <RevealText text="Official statutory notices, annual reports, guidelines, and frameworks issued by the Value for Money Office in accordance with Act 1172." delay={0.3} wordDelay={0.02} />
              </p>
            </motion.div>

            <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr", gap: "32px" }}>
              <style>{`@media (min-width: 992px) { .theater-grid { grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr !important; } }`}</style>

              <div className="theater-grid" style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr", gap: "32px" }}>
                
                {!isMobile && featuredNotice && (
                  <Reveal delay={0.1} y={30}>
                    <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
                      <motion.div key={featuredNotice.id || featuredNotice.title} initial={prefersReduced ? { opacity: 1 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.98 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} exit={prefersReduced ? { opacity: 1 } : { opacity: 0, position: "absolute" }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: "easeOut" }} style={{ backgroundColor: "#0A2E4D", borderRadius: "16px", overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", height: "100%", boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)" }}>
                        <div style={{ position: "relative", height: "300px", overflow: "hidden" }}>
                          <img src={featuredNotice.image} alt="" style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "cover" }} />
                          <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, background: "linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10,46,77,0) 20%, rgba(10,46,77,1) 100%)" }} />
                          <div style={{ position: "absolute", top: "24px", left: "24px", backgroundColor: "#FCD116", color: "#001F3F", padding: "6px 14px", borderRadius: "4px", fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: "800", letterSpacing: "1px", textTransform: "uppercase" }}>{featuredNotice.tag}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ padding: "0 24px 32px", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", flex: 1, marginTop: "-20px", position: "relative", zIndex: 2 }}>
                          <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#94A3B8", fontWeight: "600", marginBottom: "12px", display: "block" }}>{featuredNotice.date}</span>
                          <h2 style={{ fontSize: "clamp(20px, 3vw, 28px)", fontWeight: "800", color: "#FFFFFF", margin: "0 0 16px 0", lineHeight: "1.2" }}>{featuredNotice.title}</h2>
                          <p style={{ fontSize: "15px", color: "#CBD5E1", lineHeight: "1.7", margin: "0 0 24px 0", flex: 1 }}>{featuredNotice.desc}</p>
                          <div style={{ borderTop: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)", paddingTop: "20px", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}><span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#64748B" }}>Value for Money Office</span></div>
                        </div>
                      </motion.div>
                    </AnimatePresence>
                  </Reveal>
                )}

                <div>
                  <div style={{ marginBottom: "16px", paddingLeft: "8px" }}>
                    <h3 style={{ fontSize: "18px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#FFFFFF", margin: 0 }}>{isMobile ? "Live Statutory Updates" : "Up Next"}</h3>
                  </div>

                  {!isMobile ? (
                    <div className="playlist-container hide-scrollbar">
                      <div className="playlist-track">
                        {playlistNotices.map((notice, index) => {
                          const originalIndex = index % notices.length;
                          const isActive = activeNoticeIndex === originalIndex;
                          return (
                            <div key={index} className="playlist-card-wrapper" onClick={() => setActiveNoticeIndex(originalIndex)}>
                              <motion.div whileHover={prefersReduced ? {} : { backgroundColor: isActive ? "#133E66" : "#1A426B" }} style={{ backgroundColor: isActive ? "#133E66" : "#0A2E4D", borderRadius: "12px", padding: "16px", border: isActive ? "1px solid #FCD116" : "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)", display: "flex", gap: "16px", cursor: "pointer", transition: "background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease" }}>
                                <div style={{ width: "100px", height: "70px", borderRadius: "6px", overflow: "hidden", flexShrink: 0 }}><img src={notice.image} alt="" style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "cover" }} /></div>
                                <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", justifyContent: "center" }}>
                                  <span style={{ fontSize: "10px", fontWeight: "800", color: isActive ? "#FCD116" : "#94A3B8", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "1px", marginBottom: "4px" }}>{notice.tag}</span>
                                  <h4 style={{ fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: "700", color: isActive ? "#FFFFFF" : "#CBD5E1", margin: 0, lineHeight: "1.4", display: "-webkit-box", WebkitLineClamp: 2, WebkitBoxOrient: "vertical", overflow: "hidden" }}>{notice.title}</h4>
                                </div>
                              </motion.div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div ref={mobileNewsRef} className="mobile-scroll-container" onTouchStart={handleNewsTouchStart} onTouchEnd={handleNewsTouchEnd}>
                      {playlistNotices.map((notice, index) => {
                        const originalIndex = index % notices.length;
                        return (
                          <div key={index} className="mobile-news-card" onClick={() => setActiveNoticeIndex(originalIndex)} style={{ backgroundColor: "#0A2E4D", borderRadius: "12px", padding: "14px", border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "14px", cursor: "pointer", flexShrink: 0, boxShadow: "0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)" }}>
                            <div style={{ width: "100%", height: "140px", borderRadius: "8px", overflow: "hidden" }}><img src={notice.image} alt="" style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "cover" }} /></div>
                            <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>
                              <span style={{ fontSize: "10px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#FCD116", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "1px", marginBottom: "6px" }}>{notice.tag}</span>
                              <h4 style={{ fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#FFFFFF", margin: 0, lineHeight: "1.4", display: "-webkit-box", WebkitLineClamp: 2, WebkitBoxOrient: "vertical", overflow: "hidden" }}>{notice.title}</h4>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section style={{ backgroundColor: "#F4F5F0", padding: "80px 24px 100px", position: "relative", zIndex: 2 }}>
          <div style={{ position: "absolute", top: "-40px", left: 0, right: 0, height: "80px", backgroundColor: "#F4F5F0", borderRadius: "50% 50% 0 0 / 100% 100% 0 0" }} />

          <div style={{ maxWidth: "1200px", margin: "0 auto", position: "relative", zIndex: 3 }}>
            <Reveal>
              <div style={{ marginBottom: "32px" }}>
                <h2 style={{ fontSize: "clamp(24px, 4vw, 32px)", fontWeight: "800", color: "#001F3F", margin: 0 }}>
                  <RevealText text="Official Publications Repository" delay={0.05} />
                </h2>
                {isMobile && <p style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#64748B", margin: "8px 0 0 0" }}>Swipe horizontally to browse all publications. Tap to read.</p>}
              </div>
            </Reveal>

            {!isMobile && (
              <Reveal delay={0.1}>
                <div className="tabs-container" onMouseEnter={() => setIsHovered(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setIsHovered(false)} style={{ display: "flex", gap: "12px", marginBottom: "40px", flexWrap: "nowrap" }}>
                  {filters.map((filter, index) => {
                    const isActive = activeFilter === filter;
                    return (
                      <button key={`${filter}-${index}`} onClick={() => setActiveFilter(filter)} style={{ padding: "12px 24px", borderRadius: "6px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", cursor: "pointer", border: isActive ? "1px solid #001F3F" : "1px solid #CBD5E1", backgroundColor: isActive ? "#001F3F" : "#FFFFFF", color: isActive ? "#FFFFFF" : "#475569", transition: "all 0.2s ease", flexShrink: 0, whiteSpace: "nowrap", boxShadow: isActive ? "0 4px 12px rgba(0,31,63,0.15)" : "none", minWidth: "max-content" }}>
                        {filter}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </Reveal>
            )}

            <div style={{ minHeight: "350px" }}>
              {!isMobile ? (
                <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
                  <motion.div key={activeFilter} initial={prefersReduced ? { opacity: 1 } : { opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: "easeOut" }} style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 320px), 1fr))", gap: "24px" }}>
                    {desktopFilteredDocuments.map((doc, index) => (
                      <motion.div key={index} whileHover={prefersReduced ? {} : { y: -4, boxShadow: "0 20px 40px -10px rgba(0,31,63,0.08)", borderColor: "#CBD5E1" }} style={{ backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", borderRadius: "16px", padding: "32px", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", boxShadow: "0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.02)", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0", transition: "border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease", position: "relative", overflow: "hidden" }}>
                        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-start", marginBottom: "24px" }}>
                          <div style={{ width: "56px", height: "56px", borderRadius: "16px", backgroundColor: "#F0F4F8", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}><HandDrawnDocument /></div>
                          <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#64748B", fontWeight: "600", backgroundColor: "#F8FAFC", padding: "4px 10px", borderRadius: "4px" }}>{doc.date}</span>
                        </div>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: "11px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#8B7355", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "1px", marginBottom: "8px", display: "block" }}>{doc.category}</span>
                        <h3 style={{ fontSize: "20px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A", margin: "0 0 16px 0", lineHeight: "1.4" }}>{doc.title}</h3>
                        <p style={{ fontSize: "15px", color: "#475569", lineHeight: "1.6", margin: "0 0 32px 0", flex: 1 }}>{doc.desc}</p>
                        <div style={{ borderTop: "1px solid #F1F5F9", paddingTop: "24px", display: "flex", justifyContent: "flex-end" }}>
                          <button style={{ backgroundColor: "#001F3F", color: "#FFFFFF", border: "none", padding: "12px 24px", borderRadius: "8px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "700", cursor: "pointer", display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", transition: "background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.1s ease", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }} onMouseEnter={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = "#0A2E4D"; }} onMouseLeave={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = "#001F3F"; }} onMouseDown={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.transform = "scale(0.97)")} onMouseUp={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.transform = "scale(1)")}>
                            <HandDrawnDownloadIcon /> Download <span style={{ opacity: 0.7, fontWeight: "500", fontSize: "13px" }}>({doc.fileSize})</span>
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </motion.div>
                    ))}
                  </motion.div>
                </AnimatePresence>
              ) : (
                <div ref={mobileDocsRef} className="mobile-scroll-container" onTouchStart={handleDocsTouchStart} onTouchEnd={handleDocsTouchEnd}>
                  {mobileDisplayedDocuments.map((doc, index) => (
                    <div key={index} className="mobile-doc-card" onClick={() => setActiveDocIndex(index)} style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
                      <div style={{ padding: "24px 20px", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", flex: 1 }}>
                        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-start", marginBottom: "16px" }}>
                          <div style={{ width: "46px", height: "46px", borderRadius: "12px", backgroundColor: "#F0F4F8", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}><HandDrawnDocument /></div>
                          <span style={{ fontSize: "11px", color: "#64748B", fontWeight: "600", backgroundColor: "#F8FAFC", padding: "4px 8px", borderRadius: "4px" }}>{doc.date}</span>
                        </div>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: "10px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#8B7355", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "1px", marginBottom: "6px", display: "block" }}>{doc.category}</span>
                        <h3 style={{ fontSize: "17px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A", margin: "0 0 12px 0", lineHeight: "1.35", display: "-webkit-box", WebkitLineClamp: 2, WebkitBoxOrient: "vertical", overflow: "hidden" }}>{doc.title}</h3>
                        <p style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#475569", lineHeight: "1.5", margin: "0 0 20px 0", flex: 1, display: "-webkit-box", WebkitLineClamp: 3, WebkitBoxOrient: "vertical", overflow: "hidden" }}>{doc.desc}</p>
                        <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "6px", fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: "700", color: "#001F3F", marginTop: "auto" }}>
                          Read & Download <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5"><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"></line><polyline points="12 5 19 12 12 19"></polyline></svg>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {isMobile && activeNotice && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: "100%" }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: "100%" }} transition={{ type: "spring", damping: 25, stiffness: 200 }} style={{ position: "fixed", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, backgroundColor: "#001F3F", zIndex: 9999, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", overflowY: "auto" }}>
            <div style={{ padding: "20px 24px", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", position: "sticky", top: 0, backgroundColor: "rgba(0,31,63,0.95)", backdropFilter: "blur(10px)", zIndex: 10 }}>
              <span style={{ color: "#FCD116", fontWeight: "800", fontSize: "12px", letterSpacing: "1px", textTransform: "uppercase" }}>{activeNotice.tag}</span>
              <button onClick={() => setActiveNoticeIndex(null)} style={{ background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)", border: "none", borderRadius: "50%", width: "40px", height: "40px", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", color: "#FFFFFF", cursor: "pointer" }}><HandDrawnClose /></button>
            </div>
            <div style={{ padding: "0 24px 40px" }}>
              <div style={{ borderRadius: "12px", overflow: "hidden", marginBottom: "24px", marginTop: "8px" }}><img src={activeNotice.image} alt="" style={{ width: "100%", height: "240px", objectFit: "cover", display: "block" }} /></div>
              <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#94A3B8", fontWeight: "600", marginBottom: "12px", display: "block" }}>{activeNotice.date}</span>
              <h2 style={{ fontSize: "24px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#FFFFFF", margin: "0 0 20px 0", lineHeight: "1.3" }}>{activeNotice.title}</h2>
              <p style={{ fontSize: "16px", color: "#CBD5E1", lineHeight: "1.8", margin: "0 0 32px 0" }}>{activeNotice.desc}</p>
              <div style={{ borderTop: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)", paddingTop: "24px", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}><span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#64748B" }}>Value for Money Office</span></div>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {isMobile && activeDocIndex !== null && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: "100%" }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: "100%" }} transition={{ type: "spring", damping: 25, stiffness: 200 }} style={{ position: "fixed", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, backgroundColor: "#F4F5F0", zIndex: 9999, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", overflowY: "auto" }}>
            <div style={{ padding: "20px 24px", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", position: "sticky", top: 0, backgroundColor: "rgba(244,245,240,0.95)", backdropFilter: "blur(10px)", zIndex: 10, borderBottom: "1px solid #E2E8F0" }}>
              <span style={{ color: "#8B7355", fontWeight: "800", fontSize: "12px", letterSpacing: "1px", textTransform: "uppercase" }}>{mobileDisplayedDocuments[activeDocIndex].category}</span>
              <button onClick={() => setActiveDocIndex(null)} style={{ background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.05)", border: "none", borderRadius: "50%", width: "40px", height: "40px", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", color: "#001F3F", cursor: "pointer" }}><HandDrawnClose /></button>
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ padding: "24px", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", flex: 1 }}>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "16px", marginBottom: "24px" }}>
                <div style={{ width: "56px", height: "56px", borderRadius: "16px", backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", boxShadow: "0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)" }}><HandDrawnDocument /></div>
                <div>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#64748B", fontWeight: "600", display: "block", marginBottom: "4px" }}>{mobileDisplayedDocuments[activeDocIndex].date}</span>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#001F3F", fontWeight: "700" }}>Size: {mobileDisplayedDocuments[activeDocIndex].fileSize}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <h2 style={{ fontSize: "26px", fontWeight: "800", color: "#0F172A", margin: "0 0 20px 0", lineHeight: "1.3" }}>{mobileDisplayedDocuments[activeDocIndex].title}</h2>
              <p style={{ fontSize: "16px", color: "#475569", lineHeight: "1.8", margin: "0 0 32px 0", flex: 1 }}>{mobileDisplayedDocuments[activeDocIndex].desc}</p>
            </div>

            <div style={{ padding: "24px", paddingBottom: "40px", backgroundColor: "#F4F5F0", position: "sticky", bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>
              <button 
                style={{ 
                  backgroundColor: "#001F3F", 
                  color: "#FFFFFF", 
                  border: "none", 
                  width: "100%", 
                  minWidth: "100%",
                  padding: "16px 20px", 
                  borderRadius: "8px", 
                  fontSize: "16px", 
                  fontWeight: "700", 
                  cursor: "pointer", 
                  display: "flex", 
                  alignItems: "center", 
                  justifyContent: "center", 
                  gap: "10px",
                  boxSizing: "border-box",
                  boxShadow: "0 8px 20px rgba(0,31,63,0.2)",
                  marginBottom: "10px"
                }}
                onClick={() => setActiveDocIndex(null)}
              >
                <HandDrawnDownloadIcon />
                Download Official PDF
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: src/App.jsx
================
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, useLocation, Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import Navbar from "./components/Navbar";
import Footer from "./components/Footer";
import ScrollToTop from "./components/ScrollToTop";
import FloatingHelpButton from "./components/FloatingHelpButton";

// Public Pages
import Home from "./pages/Home";
import AboutUs from "./pages/AboutUs";
import WhatWeDo from "./pages/WhatWeDo";
import Publications from "./pages/Publications";
import Contact from "./pages/Contact";
import Portal from "./pages/Portal";
import Dashboard from "./pages/Dashboard";
import Assessments from "./pages/Assessments";
import Submit from "./pages/Submit"; 
import Track from "./pages/Track"; 
import Clearance from "./pages/Clearance"; 
import Sanctions from "./pages/Sanctions"; 
import OpenData from "./pages/OpenData"; 
import Engagement from "./pages/Engagement"; 
import ReviewPanel from "./pages/ReviewPanel"; 
import Whistleblower from "./pages/Whistleblower";
import Faq from "./pages/Faq";
import Forms from "./pages/Forms";
import Placeholder from "./pages/Placeholder";

// CMS Pages
import CMSLayout from "./cms/components/CMSLayout";
import CMSLogin from "./cms/pages/Login";
import CMSDashboard from "./cms/pages/Dashboard";
import ManagePublications from "./cms/pages/ManagePublications"; // <--- ADDED IMPORT

function Layout() {
  const location = useLocation();
  
  const isPortal = location.pathname === "/portal";
  const isDashboard = location.pathname.startsWith("/dashboard");
  const isCMS = location.pathname.startsWith("/cms");

  // --- CMS LAYOUT (Completely separate from public website) ---
  if (isCMS) {
    return (
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/cms/login" element={<CMSLogin />} />
        <Route path="/cms" element={<CMSLayout />}>
          <Route index element={<Navigate to="/cms/dashboard" replace />} />
          <Route path="dashboard" element={<CMSDashboard />} />
          <Route path="publications" element={<ManagePublications />} /> {/* <--- ADDED ROUTE */}
        </Route>
      </Routes>
    );
  }

  // --- PUBLIC WEBSITE LAYOUT ---
  return (
    <div style={{ margin: 0, padding: 0, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", minHeight: "100vh" }}>
      
      {!isPortal && !isDashboard && !isCMS && <Navbar />}
      
      <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
        <Routes>
          {/* Public Routes */}
          <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
          <Route path="/about" element={<AboutUs />} />
          
          {/* REDIRECT: /mandate now goes to /about */}
          <Route path="/mandate" element={<Navigate to="/about" replace />} />
          
          <Route path="/what-we-do" element={<WhatWeDo />} />
          <Route path="/publications" element={<Publications />} />
          
          {/* REDIRECT: /news now goes to /publications */}
          <Route path="/news" element={<Navigate to="/publications" replace />} />
          
          <Route path="/contact" element={<Contact />} />
          <Route path="/faq" element={<Faq />} />
          <Route path="/forms" element={<Forms />} />
          
          {/* Public Submission, Tracking, Clearance, Sanctions, Open Data & Engagement Routes */}
          <Route path="/submit" element={<Submit />} />
          <Route path="/track" element={<Track />} />
          <Route path="/clearance" element={<Clearance />} />
          <Route path="/sanctions" element={<Sanctions />} />
          <Route path="/open-data" element={<OpenData />} />
          <Route path="/engagement" element={<Engagement />} />
          <Route path="/review-panel" element={<ReviewPanel />} />
          <Route path="/whistleblower" element={<Whistleblower />} />
          
          {/* Secure Portal Routes */}
          <Route path="/portal" element={<Portal />} />
          
          {/* Internal Dashboard Routes */}
          <Route path="/dashboard" element={<Dashboard />} />
          <Route path="/dashboard/assessments" element={<Assessments />} />
          
          {/* Fallback */}
          <Route path="*" element={<Placeholder />} />
        </Routes>
      </div>

      {!isPortal && !isDashboard && !isCMS && <Footer />}
      {!isPortal && !isDashboard && !isCMS && <ScrollToTop />}
      {!isPortal && !isDashboard && !isCMS && <FloatingHelpButton />}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <BrowserRouter>
      <Layout />
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

              About Us <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline></svg>
